products.name: Astell&Kern A&ultima SP3000T | Vacuum Tube Digital Audio Player

overviewFields.title: Description
overviewFields.value:
9% pure Silver-plating Now available in Copper finish - Limited to 1,000 units globally Dual RAYTHEON JAN6418 MIL-SPEC vintage vacuum tubes Triple Amp System (OP-AMP/Tube/Hybrid Amp Mode) with 3-step tube current options Complete separation of digital and analog signal processing (uses [x2] AK4499EX flagship DAC chips and [x2] AK4191EQ) Includes yellow calfskin case - Optional Black and Taupe leather cases also available Bloom's Take In 2021, Astell&Kern took the plunge into the portable micro tube foray with their flagship SP2000T digital audio player. SP3000T brings a number of upgrades, adopting the new flagship platform pioneered by the SP3000 but with a bump in sound, design, and UI performance.

It starts with the same size and shape as the SP3000 along with similar build and materials. But what's new are a few functional changes, some slight technical variations, and a back panel window revealing warm LEDs with active tubes.

You also get the standard A&K premium DAP feature set with flexible amp mode and gain control options to find your preferred sweet spot. From build and design to sound quality and power, SP3000T exudes excellence.

It yields a strong flagship experience across the board, and if you want something relaxed with a focus on vocals and immersive presentation of your music, SP3000T is as good as it gets. Read our full review .

Analog Warmth, Digital Precision Astell&Kern's ethos of producing immersive sound from high-resolution original music stands as a testament to the spirit of innovation and excellence embodied in the A&ultima series. Their goal was to surpass the impeccable design and high-resolution sound of their previous flagship SP3000 by crafting an audio player that truly captures the emotion and resonance of music.

Developed with this vision in mind, the A&ultima SP3000T channels the profound emotion and lasting essence of analog audio. The integration of a real vacuum tube creates an authentic analog sound complemented by cutting-edge audio technology such as TERATON ALPHA for an immersive auditory experience.

Introducing the A&ultima SP3000T — a portable audio player that defies convention, offering a unique fusion of analog and digital excellence. SP3000T Copper Edition Astell&Kern strives to create more than just sound, focusing on excellence in sound quality.

The SP3000T Copper Edition demonstrates this philosophy by delivering exceptional sound characteristics. Copper, known for its excellent sound transmission and resonance properties, typically enhances the brightness and richness of tones in musical instruments.

This quality has been repeatedly validated in A&K products using Copper for its outstanding electrical conductivity and high shielding performance. Because of its material properties, Copper oxidizes and discolors upon contact with air.

98% pure copper with a special multilayer coating that enhances durability, ensuring it maintains its beautiful color and luster without requiring special maintenance. SP3000T Copper offers more than just music - it provides an emotional experience beyond music.

True Analog Sound with Real Vacuum Tube The original vacuum tube is known for its warm sound, attributed to its distinctive rich harmonics. However, its impracticality in terms of miniaturization, primarily due to power control and footprint issues, presented a formidable obstacle, rendering it unsuitable for use in portable audio players.

In A&K's unyielding quest for innovation and refusal to compromise, they worked to bridge the gap between stationary and portable audio by infusing the essence of analog sound. These efforts eventually culminated in the pairing of the SP3000T with the RAYTHEON JAN6418 miniature vacuum tube, a mini vacuum tube popular among audiophiles.

Designed to meet military specifications and traditionally used in military communication gear, it quickly garnered recognition for its distinctively warm and soft sound, leading to its integration into regular audio devices. Sound Craftsmanship for the Ultimate Vacuum Tube Sound Due to inherent differences in noise and amplification in original vacuum tubes, Astell&Kern adopted the meticulous selection process of carefully and precisely measuring and pairing each JAN6418.

This minimizes output deviation between the left and right channels, resulting in more natural sound reproduction. Every shielding operation on the vacuum tube is carefully executed by hand to minimize potential noise interference.

And thanks to their unwavering dedication to craftsmanship, A&K has successfully brought the distinctive spatial sense and balance found in their existing players into the analog realm of vacuum tube sound. Minimizing Microphonic Noise The integration of vacuum tubes into compact, portable devices presents a formidable technical hurdle: maintain low noise level while delivering resolution and robust output.

This challenge was tackled in the SP3000T with a custom-made solution designed to minimize microphonic noise, even during minor shocks or vibrations. Independent modular, flexible PCB design-engineered separately from the main PCB Silicone case designed to absorb primary shocks from the vacuum tube Silicone tubing tailored to the vacuum tube leads to reduce shock transmission Silicone dampers around the vacuum tube suspend the tubes in the air Tube Current Option A&K developed an internal plate voltage control system which can be adjusted in three stages and directly affects the amplification rate of the vacuum tube amplifier, resulting in nuanced changes in sound texture.

Experience the subtle shifts in density and spatial presence in your headphones or IEMs as you fine-tune the current of the tube amp. *Please note the tubes do not light up when the device is in OP AMP Mode.

A&K Triple Amp System Harnessing the power of Astell&Kern's unique TERATON ALPHA technology, the A&ultima SP3000T achieves seamless harmony between the rich, authentic analog sound of a real tube and the dynamic clarity of an OP AMP. The SP3000T offers three distinct modes to cater to your audio preferences: OP AMP Mode Unparalleled high resolution and dynamics that faithfully reproduces the original sound without distortion - an Astell&Kern hallmark sound.

TUBE AMP Mode The authentic essence of analog sound, nothing compares to the warm texture and distinctive sense of space delivered by a Tube Amp. Enjoy the smooth and inviting analog sound unique to real vacuum tube technology.

HYBRID AMP Mode Departing from the traditional Vacuum Tube AMP and OP AMP modes, the SP3000T features a groundbreaking HYBRID AMP mode that seamlessly blends the best of analog warmth and high-resolution output to create a unique tonal experience. With five adjustable levels, tailor your sound for an optimal listening session.

NEW VU Meter GUI The SP3000T marks a milestone for Astell&Kern as the first device to feature a VU Meter GUI, providing a visual representation of sound levels as you indulge in your favorite music. The VU Meter, an iconic piece of audio equipment with a long-standing history, displays voltage levels of voice signals to aid volume measurement and adjustment.

Beyond its utilitarian function, the VU Meter's unique design and retro charm help to enhance the immersive music-listening experience. Additional Features and Enhancements Snapdragon Octa-Core CPU A&ultima SP3000T is equipped with a Snapdragon 6125 Octa-core processor.

Paired with 8GB of DDR4 memory as a SoC and a redesigned user interface, you'll experience a faster system response and fluid, smooth engagement. Digital Audio Remaster The SP3000T is equipped with Digital Audio Remaster (DAR) technology, developed to deliver fine, vivid sound at higher sample rates.

Sound Design with DAC Filters With the SP3000T, have fun creating your own sound style by selecting up to 6 various DAC filters provided by the DAC manufacturer. Choose from Natural, Acoustic, or Traditional tones along with Harmonic, Acoustic, or Traditional sound types.

Streaming & AK Connect A&K DAPs are seamlessly integrated with external streaming apps through the Open App Service. 5", large-screen, full 1080x1920 HD touch display.

products.name: Sennheiser IE 900 In-Ear Headphones

overviewFields.title: Description
overviewFields.value:
IE 900 - The precision-manufactured aluminum housing of the IE 900 faithfully protects the dynamic TrueResponse transducers at the heart of Sennheiser’s innovative X3R technology. Experience the peak of German audio engineering and manufacturing with earphones that deliver only the purest, most natural sound.

05% (1 kHz, 94 dB) Impedance: 16 ohms The IE 900 — goodbye to tradeoffs High-fidelity recordings are pieces of art. Just as with a valuable painting, it would be a disgrace to allow damage during transport.

The IE 900 reveals the true potential of any recording. If it’s a masterpiece, you’ll hear it.

Brilliant, sparkling treble — with no trace of sibilance. Powerful lows without creating muddy mids.

All these qualities derive from inspired feats of engineering. Take Sennheiser’s trusted 7 mm transducer, for instance.

We’ve made it just that much better for the IE 900. Or the all-new X3R triple-chamber absorber technology milled right into the solid aluminum core with its downstream acoustic vortex.

Taken together, these innovations deliver a unique level of balance and transparency — so you never have to compromise again. Explore every last detail Considerable effort goes into capturing the finest nuances of a musical performance.

Re-living the creativity and texture recorded in the studio or concert hall can be a source of great pleasure. But only if the listener’s playback equipment allows.

Our German-engineered and manufactured TrueResponse driver ensures exceptionally natural reproduction. A large part of its very precise transient response comes from the unique combination of materials in the diaphragm together with its high inner dampening.

So when the signal stops, the sound stops too. But the only thing that counts is what you, the listener, hear.

The tonality of each instrument becomes clearly audible. And it’s not just the skills of the musicians that the IE 900 reveals.

Even the acoustic properties of the room gain a new presence. Instead of remaining on the surface, you can now dive deep into complex passages — all while immersed in a breathtaking sound stage.

A new level of clarity In developing the IE 900, we faced a fundamental choice. The inherent compromises multi-driver systems require (phase issues and the resulting distortion in overlapping frequency bands) made the decision easy.

To get exactly the sound we were looking for, we designed a sophisticated system of three Helmholtz resonators — the X3R. It’s milled right into the solid aluminum housing of each earphone.

These tiny channels eliminate resonance peaks which, in less advanced products, can color the sound signature and alter the feel of your music. In addition, a complex structure in the nozzle of each earphone — the Vortex — swirls acoustic energy in these frequency bands to smooth out peaks.

An acoustic back-volume establishes balance Our goal was to achieve a transparent sound with no distracting peaks or troughs. One thing this requires is clear separation of lows and mids.

To ensure accuracy across this critical frequency band, we’ve employed what is known as an acoustic back volume. It’s a small chamber within a chamber we have tuned to manage the slope and amplitude of the base lift.

The way the back volume helps achieve such a clear and natural sound signature is by controlling the direction and overall volume of air as it moves through the transducer system. What you hear is a pleasantly disciplined bass and mid-range experience.

Unpleasant resonances and listening fatigue vanish in this small space with a big effect. The sound of manufacturing expertise We build the IE 900 exclusively at our famed German manufacturing facility.

It’s the source of the outstanding quality Sennheiser products are known for the world over. Aluminum was the material of choice for this application.

Well-suited to high-precision milling, it also provides an aesthetically pleasing, long-lasting home for electro-acoustic components. A five-axis CNC machine precision cuts each housing individually from a single block of aluminum.

The result is truly a work of art. Once anodized, the housing is highly resistant to wear and corrosion — music to the ears of any daily listener.

The drivers in each pair of IE 900s are matched during our automated manufacturing process to practically eliminate variance. The result?

A transparent soundstage with no gaps or holes. A precise fit for precise sound Working musicians rely on high-quality, form fitting earphones known as personal monitoring systems.

But we felt the privilege of enjoying perfect live sound should not be the exclusive right of the performers of the world. So, we took the comfort and secure fit of these professional solutions as inspiration for the IE 900.

Now you can enjoy a fit and quality that rival that experienced by the artists who create your music. Included with the IE 900 are silicone ear adapters and three elastic foam ear adapter sets in three different sizes.

They adapt to the natural shape of your ear for a tailored fit. We’ve all been there: an amazing piece of music spoiled by a recurring bass note that happens to match the resonant frequency of your loudspeakers or headphones.

Or rough treble sibilance that makes longer sessions uncomfortable. Such obvious deficiencies are unthinkable with the IE 900.

All you will hear is precisely what the artist intended. They’re perfect at your desk, on a train, or taking a walk through the woods.

Never have a listening session spoiled by your earphones again. It pays to have good connections In addition to outstanding sound, audiophiles appreciate durable products that are made to last.

Gold-plated Fidelity+ MMCX connectors ensure perfect contact. 8 mm-wide socket below the surface of the housing, providing strain relief.

The cables themselves are para-aramid reinforced to withstand many thousands of bend cycles. 5 mm stereo plug including headphone amps, laptops, and audio interfaces.

4 mm cables for plugging directly into hi-fi components with balanced outputs. Because when you’re looking for the most natural and immersive sound, every detail matters.

What's in the box? plate Cable clip, Cleaning tool & Cleaning cloth Presentation box with signed customer certificate & User manuals

HEAD+SUB MODE. SAY WHAT!?

We feel sound as much as we hear sound. Before the invention of headphones, music listening has always been a full-body experience.

Life-style used to be a dirty word in the world of audiophiles. Not anymore!

products.name: Enleum Amp 23-RMH Headphone Amplifier

overviewFields.title: Description
overviewFields.value:
The Enleum HPA-23RMH is a compact, reference-grade headphone amplifier built for listeners who want serious drive capability without giving up the flexibility of a battery-powered design. Based on Enleum’s acclaimed HPA-23RM platform, the HPA-23RMH is the High Power version, adding a reworked and enhanced power supply that increases current output while keeping the same slim, precision-machined form factor.

That makes the HPA-23RMH especially compelling for difficult headphones that need current, control, and headroom. It carries forward Enleum’s dual-output amplifier concept, with separate voltage and current headphone outputs, allowing it to work across a wide range of headphones and IEMs.

Use it on a desktop, run it from battery power, or keep it connected to a USB-C charger for continuous listening. High Power HPA-23RMH vs HPA-23RM The standard HPA-23RM was already Enleum’s most compact high-power headphone amplifier, delivering performance comparable to the legacy HPA-21 in a chassis less than a quarter of the size.

The HPA-23RMH takes that same foundation and pushes the current output further. The key difference is power.

35W. Voltage output remains the same at 500mW at 30 ohms.

That 35% increase in current output makes the HPA-23RMH the better choice for more demanding headphones, especially current-hungry planar designs. Voltage and Current Outputs The HPA-23RMH effectively contains two amplifier approaches in one compact chassis.

Its 1/8-inch voltage output uses a MOSFET output stage inherited from Enleum’s AMP-23R architecture, with a simplified version of the JET2 Bias circuit. This output is well suited for IEMs, portable headphones, and headphones that pair better with a conventional voltage-drive amplifier.

The 1/4-inch current output uses a bipolar transistor-based circuit descended from Enleum’s HPA-21, updated with more modern circuit refinements. This is the output that defines the HPA-23RMH.

It gives demanding headphones more current delivery, stronger control, and a more authoritative presentation than you would expect from an amplifier this thin and transportable. Ensence Module and Lossless Variable Gain At the input stage, the HPA-23RMH uses Enleum’s Ensence module, the same core concept found in the AMP-23R.

This all-discrete transistor circuit uses zero negative feedback and is designed for ultra-fast, ultra-wideband performance. It also enables Enleum’s lossless variable gain, helping preserve sound quality across different gain and volume levels.

That matters in daily use because the HPA-23RMH is built to work with a wide sensitivity range. Whether you are using sensitive IEMs or power-hungry headphones, the amplifier is designed to keep its performance intact rather than feeling optimized for only one narrow use case.

Advanced Battery Power Supply Enleum has a long history with battery-powered amplification, and the HPA-23RMH continues that approach with a compact, high-efficiency power supply design. 2 MHz SMPS power supply and ultra-low-noise regulators, allowing Enleum’s reference circuits to run from a small internal battery system without the size and heat of a traditional desktop amplifier.

Battery operation gives the HPA-23RMH a clean, self-contained power environment for portable and transportable use. For desktop listening, it can also run continuously from a USB-C charger or battery pack, making it easy to use as a fixed amplifier without treating it like a temporary travel solution.

Precision Machined Design The HPA-23RMH carries Enleum’s design language forward from the AMP-23R, with machined waveform side panels, a faceted volume knob, and a minimalist control layout. The chassis is not just about looks.

Its internal structure and side heatsinks are part of the thermal management strategy, helping the amplifier handle meaningful output power in a chassis that measures only 22mm tall. It is also a design with real recognition behind it.

The HPA-23RM platform won both the Red Dot Design Award 2022 and iF Design Award 2023, reflecting the level of mechanical finishing, proportion, and industrial design Enleum brings to the product. 5mm x 22mm Weight 750g

overviewFields.title: Newly-Developed VRDS mechanism
overviewFields.value: Starting with a drive TEAC developed that has a long record of use in broadcast applications, they added VRDS technologies, which are part of the TEAC legacy.

overviewFields.title: Vibration-Free Rigid Disc-Clamping System (VRDS)
overviewFields.value: This TEAC-original CD drive mechanism reduces rotation vibration of the disc itself as well as unwanted mechanism vibration by clamping the CD to an aluminum turntable with the same diameter and maximizing inertial mass in order to stabilize rotation. Servo current is reduced with the turntable by correcting disc warping and distortion and improving the relative optical axis precision of the pickup and disc pit side. This realizes reduced disc reading errors and outstanding audio quality.

overviewFields.title: Bridge Section Supports the VRDS
overviewFields.value: For the bridge section, TEAC carefully selected lightweight materials that are very rigid and do not transmit vibration. By naturally settling vibrations quickly, TEAC has realized a wide, dynamic sound. The bridge, which has a torus structure made of resin, is only fixed on one side, and propagation of vibration from the CD mechanism to the opposite side through the bridge is suppressed, so the entire mechanism minimizes unwanted sympathetic vibrations.

overviewFields.title: Semi-Floating Mounting
overviewFields.value: The entire CD mechanism is mounted on the sub-chassis in a semi-floating state. By controlling the transmission of vibrations between the CD mechanism and the chassis, the impact of sympathetic vibrations is abated, and natural playback sound is realized throughout the frequency range. By isolating motor vibrations from the main chassis, sympathetic vibrations within the chassis are prevented. At the same time, the CD mechanism is also isolated from external vibrations. Reading precision is also increased by isolating the CD mechanism from external vibrations.

overviewFields.title: TEAC Δ∑ (delta-sigma) Discrete DAC
overviewFields.value: Instead of an ordinary DAC IC, the DAC section, which is critical for determining the sound, is a TEAC ΔΣ (Delta Sigma) discrete DAC that consists of a discrete circuit structure that incorporates TEAC’s unique algorithms using FPGA. DSD signals are left as is, while PCM signals are converted to 1-bit using a ΔΣ modulator and then output as high-quality analog signals. The sound field that is wide and perfectly clear can be realized only because of this discrete design. With a TEAC ΔΣ discrete DAC, playback of 22.5MHz DSD and 384kHz/32-bit PCM data is possible.

overviewFields.title: Dual Mono Structure
overviewFields.value: Using the independent left and right toroidal core transformers, TEAC has employed an indulgent dual mono structure for the circuitry from the power supply circuit through the D/A converter section to the analog output stage. The dual mono structure has two sets of circuitries that provide complete mono paths for each channel. This prevents interference between the left and right signals and realizes rich musical expression that emphasizes perception of the sound space and three-dimensionality.

overviewFields.title: Fully-Balanced Transmission at Every Stage
overviewFields.value: Fully-balanced transmission of the left and right analog output signals from D/A conversion to the final output stage contributes greatly to improving the signal-to-noise ratio and extending the dynamic range. The sense of air that high-resolution audio sources have can be transmitted without loss in an even purer state.

overviewFields.title: Direct Connection with Power Amplifiers Using TEAC-QVCS
overviewFields.value: This player can be directly connected to a power amp and used without a preamp due to the inclusion of TEAC-QVCS, which is an analog variable gain amp type attenuator with a fully-balanced structure. TEAC QVCS (Quad Volume Control System) is a variable gain amp type volume control comprised of four discrete left, right, positive and negative (L+, L–, R+ and R–) circuits. This theoretically prevents "gang errors" (level discrepancies between left and right channels at low volumes) and enables extremely precise analog volume adjustment in 0.5dB increments from–95 dB to + 24 dB. The two sets of analog outputs (balanced/unbalanced) can be set to fixed or variable output.

overviewFields.title: MQA Full Decoder Enables MQA CD playback
overviewFields.value: MQA (Master Quality Authenticated) is a high-quality audio codec for playing music with the uncompromised quality of the master captured in the studio. The VRDS- 701 includes an MQA decoder that controls waveforms converted from digital to analog at a precision as high as 5ms in order to achieve analog waveforms that are more faithful to the original sound sources. By greatly reducing “temporal blur,” which tends to occur at points when sound pressure differences are extreme, including when sounds begin suddenly, playback sound that is close to the original source in terms of human hearing can be achieved. The inclusion of an MQA full decoder not only enables enjoyment of MQA CDs, it also makes decoding of MQA data from the digital inputs possible, allowing playback of MQA files from a computer when used as a USB DAC.

overviewFields.title: USB DAC, 22.5MHz DSD and 384kHz/32-bit PCM Playback
overviewFields.value: A USB Type-C port is available for digital input. The VRDS-701 is much more than a CD player. Connected to a computer with USB, it can be used as a USB DAC, enabling enjoyment of the computer audio world with high-resolution audio sources.

overviewFields.title: 2×, 4× and 8× Upconversion Using RDOT-NEO
overviewFields.value: RDOT-NEO (Refined Digital Output Technology NEO), which smoothly augments digital audio signals, provides a function to upconvert the sampling frequency of PCM digital signals 2×, 4× or 8× (up to 384 kHz). RDOT, which applies an analogous interpolation method using fluency logic, is a technology that was developed to enable the playback of frequencies higher than 20 kHz that are lost by the 44.1kHz/16-bit CD format. Based on the information read from the CD, analogous data is generated between the waveform samples. As a result, data above 20 kHz is also generated.

overviewFields.title: 10MHz External Clock Input
overviewFields.value: The 10MHz clock input allows synchronization with an external clock. In addition to improving audio quality during playback with the VRDS-701, this also enables synchronization of the entire system with a clock generator.

overviewFields.title: High-Precision Dual Clock with Low Phase Noise
overviewFields.value: This player has low phase-noise type high-precision crystal oscillators. Along with 44.1kHz for CD playback, it supports 48kHz clock, which is necessary for playing files from a computer when used as a USB DAC.

overviewFields.title: Power Supply Enhanced by Three High-Capacity Toroidal Core Transformers
overviewFields.value: In addition to a toroidal core transformer for the analog signals, the digital control section, and the CD mechanism each have independent high-capacity toroidal core transformers. Through the supply of steady current using these three toroidal core transformers, the sudden starts and stops of sounds can be expressed clearly, realizing outstanding sound linearity. The transformers are each mounted to the sub-chassis, controlling vibrations.

overviewFields.title: TEAC-HCLD 2 Enhanced-Current Output Buffer Amp Circuit
overviewFields.value: For the analog output circuit, the TEAC-HCLD 2 circuit is an enhanced-current output buffer amp that increases crucial current transmission capability. This model uses diamond buffer amps with high current output capacity as line drivers. By using a positive-negative two-circuit structure for each channel, drive can be differential with balanced output and parallel with unbalanced output. Transmitting audio signals without degrading their dynamism becomes possible with increased current supply capacity.

overviewFields.title: Headphone Amp
overviewFields.value: The headphone amp has a dedicated driver that uses a high-output circuit with low distortion, high signal-to-noise ratio and a high 2000V/μs through rate, equivalent to a current transmission enhancing output line driver. This will maximize the potential of your headphones. Bulk Pet USB communication technology enables stable data transmission When sending vast quantities of digital data for high resolution audio sources through USB cables, large discrepancies can occur in the processing loads of both the transmitting computer and the receiving USB DAC. This creates the possibility of the sound breaking up and other problems. Using Bulk Pet USB transmission technology, however, achieves constant transmission at a fixed data volume, enabling steady data transmission by smoothing the loads for processing on both ends. Since the audio quality can be altered by changing the load on the computer, four preset transmission modes can be chosen according to the desired audio quality.

overviewFields.title: Thorough Design for Vibration Control
overviewFields.value: Power transformers, which tend to generate vibration, are mounted on a floating structure, separated and isolated from the bottom panel. The side fins for heat dissipation have been tailored so that each one has a different length in order to eliminate sympathetic vibrations. Three supporting pinpoint feet made of machined steel with a unique structure The circuit board attachment screws have been kept to a minimum. Furthermore, steel pinpoint feet that use an original TEAC design with a new structure to provide a suitable amount of play in the connection between them and the bottom panel, are employed to thoroughly control vibrations that could affect audio quality.

overviewFields.title: Three Supporting Pinpoint Feet

overviewFields.title: Control Connectors Enable Coordinated Use with Other Devices
overviewFields.value: RS-232C is present for integration with popular control systems, and trigger input and output connectors enable power coordination with other devices.

overviewFields.title: Free TEAC HR Audio Player
overviewFields.value: High-resolution audio sources, up to 22.5MHz DSD or 384kHz/32-bit PCM, can be easily played from Windows and Macintosh computers using this free dedicated software. Digital audio data can be transmitted with certainty under the best conditions by simply starting the software and selecting the VRDS-701 that is connected using a USB cable. Since the software is designed for use with this product, making USB audio settings is trouble-free.

products.name: TEAC W-1200 Dual Cassette Player Recorder with Pitch Control Mic Input & USB Out (Silver)

overviewFields.title: A New Standard Double Cassette Deck for the Next-Generation
overviewFields.value: Drawing on TEAC’s proud heritage in creating world-class tape decks, the W-1200 is a best-in-class dual cassette deck for the modern age. The W-1200 features two, one-way cassette decks, mic mixing, a USB digital output and other versatile recording features. In recent times, cassette tapes have fascinated those whom have never used them, thanks to their warm, distinctly analogue sound, not to mention the ease of recording and the ability to create 'mix-tapes'. TEAC set out to create a cassette deck that combined an excellent level of performance with an interface that suits the digital audio era.

overviewFields.title: Dual Deck For Rec/Play
overviewFields.value: Two simple and reliable one-way cassette mechanisms are employed. During playback (or recording) of TAPE1, users are able to change the cassette tape in TAPE2, preparing it to play (or record) next. Since both of the decks have independent drive sections for control, when one deck is playing (or recording) users are able to operate the other deck (changing tapes, fast forwarding or rewinding,) without affecting the operation of the first deck, ensuring continuity of playback or recording. Both decks support the playback of Normal (Type I), Chrome (Type II), and Metal (Type IV) tapes, while supporting recording on Normal and Chrome-type tapes.

overviewFields.title: Noise Reduction System
overviewFields.value: The built-in noise reduction system suppresses the hiss noise that inherent in cassette tape playback. This allows cassette tapes that were recorded using Dolby NR in the past to be played back with sound quality that is close to the original.

overviewFields.title: Pitch Control + RTZ Functions
overviewFields.value: TAPE1 is equipped with a pitch control that changes playback speed (in order to restore the playback sound on old tapes to the original key) by allowing the adjustment of tape speed by ±12%. Moreover, by combining the Pitch control and A-B Repeat play, users are able to make voices easier to understand at reduced tape speeds when transcribing recorded meetings and speeches. Furthermore, both TAPE1 and TAPE2 are equipped with Return-to-Zero (RTZ) functions that make returning to them to their "0000" counter positions easy with the press of a single button.

overviewFields.title: Parallel Recording
overviewFields.value: Parallel Recording makes a pair of identical tapes at the same time on TAPE1 and TAPE2. It is a convenient way to provide someone a copy of a tape right after making a recording.

overviewFields.title: Dual Mode Rec Mute
overviewFields.value: The dual mode REC MUTE function allows users to erase unnecessary sections and to add spaces (silences) between tracks while recording. overviewFields.title: A Mastering Suite In Your Hand.
overviewFields.value: The iDSD Valkyrie isn’t just powerful – it’s personal. Designed for those who seek musicality and emotional depth, it lets you sculpt the feel of your music with technologies exclusive to the world’s best mastering houses - empowering you to become your own remastering engineer.

overviewFields.title: DSD Remastering
overviewFields.value: The iDSD Valkyrie is designed intently for those wanting to sculpt the feel and emotion of their music, to exactly how they envision it. Inspired by the artistry of mastering engineers, it features iFi’s bespoke DSD1024 Remastering algorithm, powered by a custom-coded FPGA. Similar to the technology used in Sony’s mastering studios, DSD Remastering transforms any file by increasing resolution and reducing distortion – delivering sound that rivals a professionally remastered recording.

overviewFields.title: K2
overviewFields.value: Born from the legendary Victor Studios, K2 technology was created to breathe life and emotion back into distinctly clinical sounding digital audio. To achieve this, JVCKENWOOD engineers analyzed thousands of original masters at Victor Studios, fine-tuning K2’s parameters guided purely by their own human expertise and intuition. Once exclusive to JVCKENWOOD, this remarkable technology now resides within the heart of the Valkyrie, ready to be experienced at the press of a button.

overviewFields.title: K2HD Technology
overviewFields.value: The Valkyrie incorporates two modes; ‘K2’ mode and ‘K2HD’ mode. ‘K2HD’ optionally upscales audio files to 192kHz/24-bit before applying selected K2 parameters for precise waveform shaping. It extends high frequencies to restore natural harmonics, achieving sound quality close to the original master. For those who prefer restoration without changing the sample rate, ‘K2’ mode provides a similar effect while preserving the file’s original resolution.

overviewFields.title: Perfect Your Headphones
overviewFields.value: Complementing its digital customization suite, the Valkyrie features analogue processing that transforms headphone listening into a captivating experience.

overviewFields.title: Quad-DAC Architecture
overviewFields.value: At the heart of the Valkyrie are four Burr-Brown DACs in a hybrid multi-bit configuration, drawing inspiration from iFi's long-standing experience with the legendary multi-bit Philips TDA1541A. First introduced in the Pro iDSD, this interleaved design captures the magic and impact of the iconic multi-bit chipset, but with superior low-level linearity for breathtaking detail.

overviewFields.title: Cut the Cord. Not the Quality
overviewFields.value: As pioneers of Lossless Bluetooth, iFi has equipped the Valkyrie with the latest technology to deliver CD- quality audio wirelessly, with zero data loss. It also supports genuine Hi-Res Bluetooth playback over LDAC and LHDC.

overviewFields.title: Next-Gen Compatibility
overviewFields.value: xMEMS is a cutting-edge driver technology for IEMs that uses the piezoelectric effect to deliver lightning-fast, accurate sound. The Valkyrie provides the correct bias voltage and equalization required to optimally drive xMEMS IEMs.

overviewFields.title: Colossal Battery Capacity
overviewFields.value: Lift the hood, and you’ll find four batteries, combining for a colossal 20,000mAh. Not only do batteries provide the cleanest power source, but they do so with enough life to last a flight from London to New York… and back. That’s up to 18 hours on a single charge.

overviewFields.title: Serenity in Every Detail
overviewFields.value: Today the world is busy, fast, and full of noise. iFi knows the power of music, and how it’s capable of taking you out of this world to someplace new. Somewhere tranquil, where melodies can uplift, and vocals can move you to tears. The unrivalled clarity of the ZEN CAN 3 envelops you with raw, unadulterated emotion. Hear the crack of a voice, the crescendo of a chorus, the delicate whisper of a piano – every note and nuance is delivered with breathtaking precision. The ZEN CAN 3 ignites late-night listening sessions with its ability to effortlessly drive headphones – from xMEMS-based IEMs to high-end planars – delivering up to 2,000mW output power through the same Class A circuitry found in iFi’s flagship iCAN Phantom. Isolate yourself from the chaos of the outside world with iFi’s all-new analogue EQ-modes, allowing for full immersion during intense gaming and movie marathons.

overviewFields.title: Future-Proof Features.
overviewFields.value: The ZEN CAN 3 now supports IEMs using xMEMS, an innovative micro-speaker technology pushing the boundaries of headphone performance.

overviewFields.title: Clear Voices
overviewFields.value: Have you ever experienced watching a thrilling scene only to struggle to hear what the characters are saying? This is a frustration shared by many, as streamed content often has dialogue that gets lost amidst background sounds and music. Enter movie mode, an EQ specifically designed to address the clarity of dialogue in streamed content, enabling you to fully immerse in the narrative without straining to hear or decipher what is being said.

overviewFields.title: Crisp Footsteps
overviewFields.value: Game mode caters directly to the needs of those constantly seeking any advantage they can get in competitive play. Gamers understand the importance of hearing even the faintest sounds that can give away an opponent’s position or signal an approaching threat. Game mode’s EQ enhances this aspect of gameplay by sharpening subtle, low-level sound effects, ensuring that every sound becomes more distinct and easier to pinpoint. Whether navigating through intense firefights or sneaking up on enemies, this heightened audio sensitivity allows you to stay one step ahead of opponents.

overviewFields.title: Prodigious Power
overviewFields.value: With its impressive 2,000mW output power, the ZEN CAN 3 offers a significant upgrade to the way you experience music through headphones, with unprecedented clarity and headroom. Its ability to handle dynamic peaks with ease means you can experience music as it was meant to be heard – vivid, immersive, and profoundly moving. It means more than just loudness – it’s about feeling the music resonate through you, stirring your soul and creating a connection that transcends mere sound. Whether its planar magnetic headphones requiring more power to drive accurately, or high-impedance models that need ample current delivery, the ZEN CAN 3 rises to the challenge.

overviewFields.title: Superior Components. Class A Sound.
overviewFields.value: The ZEN CAN 3 features trickle-down Class A discrete balanced circuitry from iFi’s flagship headphone amplifier. Underpinning the circuitry are cherry-picked, premium components from Panasonic, TDK, MELF, Texas Instruments and muRata. The amplification stage boasts iFi/AMR’s own ‘OV’ series op-amps, outperforming commercial chips that use low-grade copper and inexpensive aluminum bond-wire. Performance of the ZEN CAN 3 is optionally upgradable by powering with an ultra-quiet power supply. The SilentPower iPower2 boasts performance more than 10 times quieter than other audiophile solutions – ensuring the clarity you crave is never compromised.

overviewFields.title: DSP-Free Purity
overviewFields.value: Unlike other audiophile offerings, all the ZEN CAN 3’s features are done with analogue circuitry, as opposed to Digital Signal Processing (DSP), where the audio signal is manipulated before being converted to true analogue sound. Instead, the ZEN CAN 3 leverages the natural advantages of analogue circuitry: it maintains the integrity of the sound, introduces less phase shift and distortion, and boasts a more natural-sounding adjustment of frequencies.

overviewFields.title: XBass+
overviewFields.value: iFi’s signature analogue bass enhancement, XBass+, is designed to make bass hit harder without compromising the clarity of the midrange – perfect for when you’re listening with IEMs or open-back headphones that lack bass response.

overviewFields.title: XSpace
overviewFields.value: XSpace recreates the expansive soundstage of speakers, transforming headphone listening from confined and ‘inside your head’ to natural and spacious. This technology makes music come alive, offering a concert-like sound experience without losing any detail or resolution – all achieved through the innovative design of iFi’s circuitry.

products.name: iFi Audio Zen Phono 3 MM & MC Phono Stage with Subsonic Filter

overviewFields.title: Turn on, Tranquility.
overviewFields.value: In a world where modern technology is ever-evolving, simplicity and connection are what we crave most. Nothing demonstrates this quite like the familiar act of picking your favorite LP, hearing the soft crackle before it starts, and sharing a story or two with friends as you listen together. If this is the type of connection you crave, then a well-designed phono stage is integral for your vinyl setup. It takes the subtle whispers of your cartridge and amplifies them hundreds of times, making your vinyl’s magic compatible with headphones, amps, receivers and speakers. The ZEN Phono 3 opens the door to that analogue world with style and substance. With an intelligent warp filter and versatile loading options, you will be able to hear your over-loved LPs as new and fully experiment with your system setup. Packed with trickle-down technology from iFi’s prestigious history with sister company AMR, the ZEN Phono 3 is a noise-free upgrade that will allow you to slip seamlessly back into the blissful world of vinyl.

overviewFields.title: Feature

overviewFields.title: Feature
overviewFields.value: Precise RIAA with balanced output

overviewFields.title: Feature
overviewFields.value: Intelligent subsonic filter

overviewFields.title: Feature
overviewFields.value: High-tech 1.2MHz clean power supply

overviewFields.title: Super Smart. Super Subsonic.
overviewFields.value: Standard subsonic filters aren’t intelligent and are typically loathed by audiophiles. They filter not only the bass rumble from warped records but also the bass of the song. iFi’s intelligent subsonic filter knows the difference between the two and only filters the warp, leaving the song completely intact, and without adding group delay.

overviewFields.title: Your Cartridge. Your Rules.
overviewFields.value: The ZEN Phono 3 supports four MM/MC gain selections from 36 to 72dB and four input impedance settings. Mix and match gain and loading settings independently of each other with the all-new loading button, ensuring optimum compatibility with a wide range of cartridges and allowing you to get the sound ‘just right’.

overviewFields.title: Exacting Equalization
overviewFields.value: At the vinyl mastering stage, records are pressed with an inverse RIAA equalization curve applied. This needs to be undone on playback by the phono stage to reveal the magic of the music. ZEN Phono 3’s RIAA EQ circuitry uses multiple TDK C0G capacitors in parallel. This is for best stability and the least distortion. This allows for ZEN Phono 3’s RIAA playback equalization curve to be within +/- 0.15dB tolerance from 20-20kHz, allowing you to hear your records more accurately than ever before. Its RIAA accuracy is on-par with more costly phono stages that use hand-selected capacitors.

overviewFields.title: Shockingly Silent
overviewFields.value: ZEN Phono 3 has a high-tech clean power supply built directly into it, isolated on its own “island” and away from the rest of the board. The power supply’s isolation mitigates noise pollution of the analogue stage – ensuring that only the audio is amplified and allowing for the noise-floor to remain whisper quiet. ZEN Phono 3’s Equivalent Input Noise measures at -151dBV, which is 20dBV quieter than some Stereophile Class A+ phonos.

overviewFields.value: The disc drive is built with a high-class S.V.H (Suppress Vibration Hybrid) mechanism. New, condensed signal paths and circuitry that control pickup and decode noise are minimized to prevent excess noise and preserve sound quality. The hybrid construction of the S.V.H. loader provides stability in the disc drive, allowing for the decoding and signal reading with the upmost accuracy. The low center of gravity of the mechanism suppresses vibration both inside and outside the structure. By eliminating excess vibration, servo-related operations are minimized. The reduction of unnecessary controls and current consumption allows for digital signals to be read from the disc with optimal accuracy.

overviewFields.title: DAC Master Clock Design

It replaces the subpar DAC and amplifier in smartphones, tablets, PCs, and Macs. Just connect via USB-C, plug in your favorite headphones, and enjoy rich, dynamic sound. iFi’s expertise with the Burr-Brown chipset ensures optimal performance. However, a superior DAC stage involves more than just the DAC chip. A crucial element is the XMOS chip for processing digital audio inputs. The hip-dac 3 features a 16-core XMOS microcontroller, programmed by iFi’s in-house team to optimize sound quality and ensure a perfect hi-res partnership with the Burr-Brown DAC.

overviewFields.title: hip-dac 3 Your Power-Hungry Headphone
overviewFields.value: The hip-dac 3 features a true balanced circuit design, rare for its price range. This design minimizes signal distortion, resulting in a purer, more captivating sound for your headphones. The circuitry incorporates high-quality components, including a custom iFi OV op-amp, a low-noise power supply IC from Texas Instruments, and a premium analogue volume pot. The amp stage can deliver up to 400mW into a 32-ohm headphone load, making it compatible with a wide range of headphones. Additionally, it efficiently drives high-impedance headphones with an output voltage of 6.3V into 600 ohms from the balanced output.

overviewFields.title: Tailored For Your Headphones and Earphones
overviewFields.value: The amp stage has switchable gain, called PowerMatch, to ensure optimal power for the headphones you are using. An underside switch engages iFi’s iEMatch technology, optimizing output for high-sensitivity headphones, especially in-ear monitors (IEMs). It reduces hiss, enhances detail and dynamic range, and improves volume control range. XBass is a user-selectable feature that boosts bass without muddying the midrange, ideal for your earphones and open-back headphones. It works in the analogue domain, avoiding alterations via DSP.

overviewFields.title: Play All Your Files, Including MQA
overviewFields.value: Hi-res PCM and DXD audio data is supported at sample rates up to 384kHz, alongside DSD from 2.8MHz to 12.4MHz (DSD64, 128 and 256). Full decoding of MQA – the hi-res streaming technology, as used by Tidal’s ‘HiFi Plus’ tier – is also supported, performing the full ‘three unfold’ decoding process (as opposed to just the final unfold in the manner of an MQA ‘renderer’). Either side of the rotary volume control reside a pair of LEDs that change color to indicate the format and sample rate of the incoming audio.

overviewFields.title: Get Connected
overviewFields.value: The hip-dac 3’s USB-C input supports up to 32-bit/384kHz audio, compatible with USB 3.0 and 2.0. Its asynchronous design ensures jitter-free data transfer. A separate USB-C charging port allows use while charging, preserving a pure audio signal path. The hip-dac 3 provides two outputs: a 3.5mm socket for single-ended headphones and a 4.4mm balanced output for those with balanced connectivity, leveraging the device’s differential amp design. The 3.5mm output utilizes iFi’s S-Balanced circuitry, minimizing crosstalk and distortion for single-ended connections. The hip-dac 3’s 2,200mAh battery offers up to 12 hours of playtime, varying by volume and headphone power needs. It includes a USB-C OTG cable and a USB-A to USB-C cable.

overviewFields.title: Can I use Bluetooth as soon as I plug in the speaker?
overviewFields.value: Era 100 must first be set up on WiFi using the Sonos app. Following setup, you can easily pair a Bluetooth device by pressing the button on the back of the speaker. Please note that if you use a pair as rear speakers for home theater surround sound, Bluetooth will be disabled.

overviewFields.title: Where should I place Era 100?
overviewFields.value: Designed for versatility, Era 100 fits almost anywhere, including enclosed spaces such as a bookshelf. It’s also humidity resistant, so you can place it in the kitchen or on a covered patio.

overviewFields.title: Does Era 100 support stereo pairing?
overviewFields.value: Yes. For an even wider soundstage, you can stereo pair two Era 100 speakers in the same room. These can also be used as rear speakers for surround sound with Arc, Beam (any generation), or Ray. Era 100 will not pair with Sonos One, One SL, or Play:1.

overviewFields.title: Which soundbars can I use with Era 100 for surround sound?
overviewFields.value: Pair two Era 100 speakers with Arc, Beam (any generation), or Ray for surround sound. Era 100 is not compatible with Playbar or Playbase.

overviewFields.title: How do I use Trueplay™ to tune Era 100?
overviewFields.value: The Trueplay tuning experience differs slightly for Android and iOS. With an Android device, Trueplay relies on the microphones of the speaker. With an iOS device, you have the option to use this Trueplay method  (referred to as Quick Tuning in the Sonos app) or the traditional method (referred to as Advanced Tuning) which uses the microphones in your iPhone or iPad and requires you to move around the room. Please note that if you use a pair of Era 100 speakers for surround sound with your Sonos soundbar, Trueplay will require a supported iOS device.

overviewFields.title: Which subwoofer should I pair with Era 100?
overviewFields.value: We recommend pairing Era 100 with Sub Mini or Sub. All generations of Sub are compatible.

overviewFields.title: Can I experience Dolby Atmos with Era 100?
overviewFields.value: The acoustic architecture of Era 100 does not support playback of spatial audio content.

overviewFields.title: How can I use line in?
overviewFields.value: To connect an audio device directly to Era 100, you need to use the Sonos Line-In Adapter and a 3.5 mm auxiliary cable, both sold separately.

overviewFields.title: What's the difference between Bluetooth and WiFi?
overviewFields.value: A WiFi connection provides the best listening experience, allowing you to stream lossless audio from anywhere in your home. Bluetooth allows you to quickly connect a phone, tablet, or laptop to your speaker and stream compressed audio directly from the paired device — without the Sonos app but within a limited range.

overviewFields.title: Can I use Bluetooth with a stereo pair?
overviewFields.value: If you have created a stereo pair, you can still stream audio using Bluetooth. Please note that if you use a pair of speakers for home theater surround sound, Bluetooth and Line-In will be disabled.

overviewFields.title: Can I group speakers while using Bluetooth?
overviewFields.value: Yes. Similar to the experience with Sonos Roam and Move, if you are playing content from a Bluetooth source, you can group Era 100 with other products in your Sonos system that are connected to WiFi.

overviewFields.title: Can I use a third-party adapter for line in?
overviewFields.value: No. Most, if not all, of the USB-C to 3.5 mm adapters on the market today are intended for line out (headphones) and do not.

overviewFields.title: Where should I place Era 300?
overviewFields.value: For optimal sound quality, Era 300 should be placed indoors and have approximately two feet of overhead clearance. Placement in an enclosed space such as a bookshelf is not recommended as this could impact dispersion and playback clarity.

overviewFields.title: Does Era 300 support stereo pairing?
overviewFields.value: Yes. For an even wider soundstage and more depth, pair two Era 300 speakers in the same room. These can also be used as rear speakers for multichannel surround sound with Arc or Beam (Gen 2).

overviewFields.title: What soundbars will pair with Era 300 for surround sound?
overviewFields.value: Because Era 300 is a multichannel rear speaker, it requires a Sonos soundbar that supports Dolby Atmos, i.e. Arc or Beam (Gen 2). For this reason, Era 300 is not compatible with Playbar, Playbase, Beam (Gen 1), or Ray.

overviewFields.title: Which subwoofer should I pair with Era 300?
overviewFields.value: Era 300 has great bass on its own.  For a richer, more powerful sound experience, we recommend pairing Era 300 with Sub (any generation).

overviewFields.title: What is spatial audio?
overviewFields.value: While audio mixed in stereo is limited to left and right channels with elements localized within a horizontal plane, spatial audio technologies, such as Dolby Atmos, allow creators to place individual sounds all around you in 3D space for a more immersive and realistic listening experience. When you enjoy spatial audio content on Era 300, the speaker receives the audio signal and re-creates the immersive sound field in your home.

overviewFields.title: How can I experience spatial audio on Era 300?
overviewFields.value: To experience music in spatial audio, you’ll need to be connected to WiFi and streaming Dolby Atmos Music from a supported service. Refer to https://support.sonos.com/article/listen-to-dolby-atmos-music-on-sonos for more information.

overviewFields.title: Can I use Bluetooth® as soon as I plug in the speaker?
overviewFields.value: Era 300 must first be set up on WiFi using the Sonos app. Following setup, you can easily pair a Bluetooth device by pressing the button on the back of the speaker. Please note that if you use a pair as rear speakers for home theater surround sound, Bluetooth will be disabled.

overviewFields.title: What's the difference between Bluetooth and WiFi?
overviewFields.value: A WiFi connection provides the best listening experience, allowing you to stream lossless and spatial audio from anywhere in your home. Bluetooth allows you to quickly connect a phone, tablet, or laptop to your speaker and stream audio directly from the paired device — without the Sonos app but within a limited range.

overviewFields.title: Can I use Bluetooth with a stereo pair?
overviewFields.value: If you have created a stereo pair, you can still stream audio using Bluetooth. Please note that if you use a pair of speakers for home theater surround sound, Bluetooth and Line-In will be disabled.

overviewFields.title: Can I group speakers while using Bluetooth?
overviewFields.value: Yes. Similar to the experience with Sonos Roam and Move, if you are playing content from a Bluetooth source, you can group Era 300 with other products in your Sonos system that are connected to WiFi.

overviewFields.title: How can I use line in?
overviewFields.value: To connect an audio device directly to Era 300, you need to use the Sonos Line-In Adapter and a 3.5 mm auxiliary cable, both sold separately.

overviewFields.title: How do I connect my turntable to Sonos?
overviewFields.value: You can connect your turntable to Era 300 using the Sonos Line-In Adapter and an auxiliary cable.

ORA bridges the gap between computer speakers and studio monitors giving you studio-grade, audiophile-approved sound without dominating your space. ORA has modern inputs like USB-C to get the best sound from your PC or Mac, Bluetooth ® 5.0 to pair with your phone or smart home device, and RCA for your analog gear. Sporting a crossover that automatically sends bass to a connected subwoofer, you get flawless low-end integration freeing up the 3” woofers and ¾” silk dome tweeters to focus on what they do best. ORA is the perfect blend of reference-quality sound and modern features at a compact size to fit on your desktop.

overviewFields.title: Reference Quality
overviewFields.value: 100W of DSP-tuned, bi-amplified Class-D power for near studio-grade sound with shockingly deep bass from its 3” woofers. Linear enough to pull double duty as a studio monitor and a multimedia speaker.

overviewFields.title: Plug ‘N Play
overviewFields.value: ORA desktop speakers feature three inputs covering your digital and analog needs. USB-C to get the best sound from your PC or Mac, Bluetooth 5.0 pairs seamlessly with your phone or smart home device, and RCA for your analog gear.

overviewFields.title: Seamless Sub Integration
overviewFields.value: A crossover network kicks in automatically when a sub is connected letting ORA focus on vocals and high frequencies. By relieving ORA of sub-bass duties, you can play louder with less distortion.

overviewFields.title: Compact Size
overviewFields.value: Coming in at a fraction of the size of full-size bookshelf speakers, ORA is small enough to place sideways under a monitor or toss into a backpack for an impromptu recording session.

overviewFields.title: Retro Friendly
overviewFields.value: With magnetically shielded drivers, there’s no fear of placing ORA directly beside your CRT or high-end PVM. Hear every square wave and sawtooth in stunning detail from the analog RCA input.

overviewFields.title: Rear Mountable
overviewFields.value: A 1/4”-20 threaded insert located at the rear of each speaker lets you wall, or ceiling mount ORA with any compatible speaker mounting bracket.

overviewFields.title: Model
overviewFields.value: ORAMG

products.name: Kanto ORA4 Powered Bluetooth Desktop Speakers - Pair (Matte Black)

overviewFields.title: Pro Audio for The People
overviewFields.value: ORA4 takes the legacy of ORA to the next level by pushing bass extension even deeper while maintaining the same, great, reference-quality sound. Leaning further into the world of pro audio, ORA4 offers a flat, full-range frequency response to ensure mixes are dialed-in, and music sounds true-to-life. USB-C gives you a bit-perfect connection to your PC or Mac, Bluetooth 5.0 lets you wirelessly stream from a phone or smart home device, and RCA allows you to connect analog gear. When a subwoofer is plugged in, ORA4 automatically applies a high-pass filter to the 4” woofers keeping distortion at bay. ORA4 takes a no-nonsense approach to delivering studio-grade sound with modern features at a manageable size - perfect for nearly any scenario you throw it in.

overviewFields.title: Pro Sound
overviewFields.value: If your speakers aren’t neutral, you’re not hearing what the artist intended. Delivering 140 W of DSP tuned, bi-amplified Class-D power, ORA4 produces studio-grade sound with deep, authoritative bass from its 4” woofers. Accurate enough to work as a monitor and refined enough for HiFi use.

overviewFields.title: Jack Of All Trades
overviewFields.value: Equal parts bookshelf speaker, studio monitor, and computer speaker. ORA4 feels equally at home in virtually any scenario and is perfectly sized for any stand mount or desktop setup. Great sound in a compact package for gamers, creators, musicians, and audiophiles.

overviewFields.title: Modern Connections
overviewFields.value: To cover your digital and analog needs, ORA4 offers three inputs - USB-C for flawless sound from your PC or Mac, Bluetooth 5.0 for pairing with your phone or smart home device, and RCA for your analog gear. An endless amount of audio sources work with ORA4 from the past, present, or future.

overviewFields.title: Subwoofer Integration
overviewFields.value: You don’t have to sacrifice fidelity for low-end grunt. When a subwoofer is connected, a crossover network activates automatically, allowing ORA4 to concentrate on vocals and high frequencies. By offloading bass, ORA4 can play louder with less distortion improving overall sound quality.

overviewFields.title: Mounting Options
overviewFields.value: Two 1/4”-20 threaded inserts located at the rear, and bottom, of each speaker let you secure ORA4 to any compatible speaker mount or bracket. Whether you want to free up space by mounting them on a wall, or simply find the perfect spot in your room, you have the flexibility to place them wherever works best.

overviewFields.title: Pixel Perfect
overviewFields.value: Placing a magnet beside your tube TV is a sure-fire way to distort picture quality and lower its HP. ORA4’s woofers are magnetically shielded allowing you to place them beside your CRT or PVM without any worries. The RCA input gives you a direct connection to hear your favorite retro soundtracks in all their glory.

products.name: iFi Audio iPower X 15V Active Noise Cancelling DC Power Supply

overviewFields.title: Pure silence. Clean power to the maX.
overviewFields.value: With crème de la crème components and tech, the iFi iPower X deep cleans the background noise created in your mains power. Can now be used with a wider variety of equipment.

overviewFields.title: Silence. Personified.
overviewFields.value: The original iFi iPower provides an effective, clean power solution for noise in your system. But why not push your power upgrade to the max with the all-new iFi iPower X? iFi's new ultra-low noise AC/DC power supply has be optimized to take advantage of new knowledge, components and tech in the world of super high-frequency power supply design.

overviewFields.title: Active cancellation
overviewFields.value: The iPower X uses Active Noise Cancellation II  to cancel all incoming EMI or RFI noise. This is the same tech as in active noise-cancelling headphones! Imagine how well these block out cabin noise on a plane compared to regular headphones? This is what the iPower X does to your power supply.

overviewFields.title: Improved capacitance
overviewFields.value: As usual with iFi, every new design means not only improving how it looks on the outside but more importantly, how it functions on the inside. The input capacitance is now 50% larger and the output capacitance is 150% larger when compared to the original iPower. In practical terms, this gives you more filtration, improved dynamics and unsurpassed sound quality.

overviewFields.title: Crème de la crème components
overviewFields.value: iFi is using the latest solid organic capacitors for better suppression of high-frequency noise. And the leakage capacitance is some 20x lower than your normal SMPS! In a nutshell, there is no escape for unwanted noise! All in all, the iPower X will give you 20% more power than the original iFi iPower and increased amperage which means it can work with more equipment than ever before.

overviewFields.title: Sleek, modern design
overviewFields.value: The iPower X comes dressed in a new cream/beige chassis for a cool, clean look. We’ve added several openings and the iFi logo backlit by a pleasant cyan LED light. There’s no second-guessing when this mini work of art is on and connected to the mains. And as always, iFi is giving you freedom. The iPower X is interchangeable with wall pin types across the world (UK/US/EU/AU purchased separately).

overviewFields.title: Because iFi plays music too…
overviewFields.value: Musician? Loving your effect pedals but not so much one when goes down in the middle of a gig? And your spare is nowhere to be found? iFi iPower X has a centre negative adapter so you can use this correctly with your gear. Cleaner sound AND the show goes on! What’s not to like?

overviewFields.title: iPowerX for LED lights
overviewFields.value: Photography? No way. iPowerX can also solve my flickering LED light problem? Yes, a constant current and voltage power supply like iPowerX will ensure that the current supplied to your LED system will remain stable, no matter the fluctuations of the AC power in your wall socket.

overviewFields.title: Vanish Into the Music
overviewFields.value: iFi’s new reference-class analogue headphone amp, the iCAN PHANTOM, takes the Pro iCAN, refines and enhances every element of its circuitry to further elevate its performance, incorporates technology from the Pro iESL ­– previously a separate component – for electrostatic headphones, and adds a new, advanced user interface and network-connected control system. The result? A headphone amp truly worthy of its flagship status.

overviewFields.title: Feature

overviewFields.title: A New Extraordinary Reference
overviewFields.value: Exemplary build quality, sophisticated technology, an unrivalled specification and remarkable versatility, expertly engineered to drive every headphone type to its full sonic potential. From ultra-sensitive IEMs, to the finest dynamic driver and planar magnetic headphones, to the most power-hungry electrostatic designs, the iCAN PHANTOM delivers a truly exceptional headphone experience – exquisitely tailored to the requirements of the listener.

overviewFields.title: The Rolls-Royce of Flagships
overviewFields.value: The iCAN PHANTOM’s design gives the appearance of two units but in fact it is a single, dual-level device, the full depth of which is fully utilized by its multi-layer circuit design. Its enclosure is sturdily constructed from aluminum, with the bottom layer sporting cable connections front and back, and the top layer offering tactile controls and a colorful OLED display. The top of the iCAN PHANTOM incorporates a flush-fitting smoked glass panel enabling you to see the amp’s circuitry and its glowing audio valves. Circular aluminum vents ensure the circuitry within does not overheat. When not in use the sockets at the front or back can be hidden by a neat aluminum panel that attaches magnetically. This panel also holds the data cards for the electrostatic bias voltage settings. The iCAN PHANTOM also comes with an attractive, easy to use aluminum, high quality, remote control.

overviewFields.title: A Tale of Two Input Stages
overviewFields.value: The iCAN PHANTOM sports two input stages – one valve/tube-based, the other solid state – enabling the user to switch between the two in real time. It is, indeed, like having three amplifiers in one, each with a different sonic presentation. Solid-state offers pace and immediacy. Tube mode adds fluidity and a free-breathing dynamic quality. Tube+ accentuates the sonic influence of the valves, delivering a spellbinding romantic warmth that may suit, for example, acoustic and vocal musical styles.

overviewFields.title: Electrostatically Good!
overviewFields.value: Most headphones create sound by using dynamic (or moving coil) drivers to move air. A smaller number use planar magnetic diaphragms, which are different in form and operation, but still use magnetic fields to cause motion. At the high end of the headphone scene there is another, rare but fabulous sounding driver type – electrostatic headphones.

overviewFields.title: Bias Voltage Simplified
overviewFields.value: Electrostatic headphones have varying requirement when it comes to bias voltage. The iCAN PHANTOM has two outputs for electrostatics – one set at the ‘normal’ bias voltage of 230V, the other offering variable bias voltage between 500V and 640V, selected by the user. If the wrong voltage is selected, it is possible to damage the headphones.

overviewFields.title: Every Connection Covered
overviewFields.value: The iCAN PHANTOM supplies a wide array of balanced and single-ended connection options. The headphone outputs are at the front, with the source inputs and preamp outputs at the rear.

overviewFields.title: iFi Nexis – Network Connected Control
overviewFields.value: The iCAN PHANTOM is the first product to incorporate iFi Nexis, a module which combines with an app to provide a comprehensive, scalable network-connected control system. The features that Nexis offers will grow over time. At launch, the Nexis app enables your Android or iOS device to act as a ‘super remote control’ for the iCAN PHANTOM, providing access to additional features not accessible via the amp’s fascia or standard remote control. The app can display diagnostic information and allow the user to monitor the iCAN PHANTOM’s operational condition in real time – for example, voltages, the condition and projected life span of the vacuum tubes and so on. It can also be used to apply over-the-air updates to the iCAN PHANTOM’s firmware, downloading and installing update files via your home Wi-Fi network.

With a specially designed driver unit, for wide frequency production, deep bass and clear vocals, these headphones are designed to immerse you in a sound so good, it feels like you’re in the studio with your favorite artists.
