overviewFields.title: Cut the Cord. Keep the Quality.
overviewFields.value: The ZEN Blue 3 offers wireless audio that is free of compromise by incorporating Lossless Bluetooth audio, courtesy of Qualcomm’s Flagship QCC518x Bluetooth audio chip and the aptX Lossless codec. Offering a maximum bitrate of 1,200kbps aptX Lossless is the first and only Bluetooth codec currently capable of wirelessly sending and receiving CD-quality audio without losing data during compression. For instance, if your phone supports aptX Lossless, you can stream high-quality lossless music from your phone to your hi-fi system. Not ready to join the Lossless party just yet? Not to worry, they’ve got you covered. The ZEN Blue 3’s extensive backwards compatibility ensures that all current major Bluetooth codecs are supported: aptX Lossless, LDAC™, LHDC/HWA, aptX Adaptive, aptX, AAC and SBC.

overviewFields.title: Forging New Connections
overviewFields.value: In this increasingly wireless world, high resolution Bluetooth headphones and TWS (True Wireless Stereo) earbuds are an essential for audio enthusiasts. However, the need for a Bluetooth connection can often make them incompatible with your home audio setup. The ZEN Blue 3 tears down this wall with Bluetooth transmission in all supported codecs, including CD-quality aptX Lossless. Connect your ZEN Blue 3 to audio sources such as laptops, mobile phones or TVs, via USB-C, SPDIF or even analogue RCA, and introduce your favorite Bluetooth headphones or earbuds to the rest of your audio world. The ZEN Blue 3 is also able to function as a fully wired DAC, offering 96kHz/24Bit audio via USB-C, or 192kHz/24Bit audio via SPDIF, which can be output via 4.4 balanced or RCA analogue outputs.

overviewFields.title: Let That Sync In
overviewFields.value: Whether you’re getting lost in a great movie or immersing yourself in your favorite video game, few things take you out of the moment quite like a delay in the audio. This is a notorious issue with other Bluetooth products, but for the ZEN Blue 3 this is simply another place to excel. When using ZEN Blue 3’s Low Latency mode with a device receiver that supports aptX Low Latency, the time taken to send and receive audio is drastically reduced. When your eyes see it, your ears hear it – putting you right back in the moment, where you belong.

overviewFields.title: Balance in All Things
overviewFields.value: With so many Hi-Res audio options available to the ZEN Blue 3, making balanced circuitry available to users is more important than ever. By including a balanced line output, users with a balanced audio setup can look forward to significantly reduced signal noise and crosstalk between channels, bringing all the clarity with none of the audio clutter.

overviewFields.title: Clear Air.
overviewFields.value: Enjoy a louder, clearer listening experience from your PC, Mac, Streamer, or TV.

overviewFields.title: ZEN Air CAN
overviewFields.value: The ZEN Air CAN is a powerful, hi-res home analog amplifier that provides greater headphone enjoyment with any analog source such as your PC, Mac, smartphone, tablet, streamer, or TV. Enjoy an improved headphone experience with the ZEN Air CAN.

overviewFields.title: Amp it up
overviewFields.value: The ZEN Air CAN is an amplifier pure and simple. It simply takes an input signal from a source such as those mentioned above and creates a larger copy of the original signal before it’s sent to your headphones. Think about listening to sounds with your hands over your ears and then removing them! Adding the ZEN Air CAN into your system is a little like that – back comes clarity of sound as well as volume.

overviewFields.title: Lots to gain…
overviewFields.value: The ZEN Air CAN comes with three gain settings so that it works well with every pair of headphones or in-ear monitors (also known as IEMs). What is gain? Gain in audio terms refers to an amplifier’s ability to increase the amplitude (size) of the signal from the source (input) to the headphones or speakers (output).  More gain equals a stronger signal. You will need to adjust the gain depending on the sensitivity of the headphones or iEMs you are using. For example, highly sensitive headphones need lower gain. Play around with the settings. Trust your ears.

overviewFields.title: eSpecially for you
overviewFields.value: The ZEN Air CAN has two different headphone sockets – 6.3mm single-ended and 4.4mm S-Balanced. There are basically two types of headphones – single-ended and balanced. In a nutshell, single-ended is the most common but the balanced option is often considered the better as it offers more power and control of the headphones. At iFi, they know not everyone has balanced headphones, so they've created S-Balanced technology. This gives you all the benefits of a balanced connection – lower noise, less crosstalk – but without the need for balanced headphones.

overviewFields.title: Sonic tailoring
overviewFields.value: The ZEN Air CAN boasts a couple of sonic tweaks, unique to iFi. XBass is an analog bass boost. In other words, it extends the bass response to suit different headphones. XSpace is an analog headphone spatializer. This opens up your music to give you the spaciousness of a live-concert atmosphere.

This enhancement results in improved low-frequency performance, delivering deep, impactful bass that enriches the overall listening experience—particularly beneficial when enjoying dynamic movie soundtracks.

overviewFields.title: Advanced Cooling System for Silent Operation
overviewFields.value: Equipped with five McIntosh Monogrammed Heatsinks™ connected to advanced high-current output transistors, the MC257 efficiently dissipates heat without the need for noisy cooling fans. This design ensures silent operation, allowing you to fully immerse yourself in your entertainment without unwanted background noise. Additionally, a specially wound toroidal isolation power transformer minimizes electrical noise, preserving audio purity.

overviewFields.title: Versatile Integration Options
overviewFields.value: The MC257 offers both balanced and unbalanced inputs, facilitating seamless integration with various home theater processors and components. Its flexible design allows it to power a 7-channel home theater independently, complement digital amplifiers like the MI128 or MI254 in larger setups, or serve a 5-channel theater while allocating two channels to a secondary audio zone.

overviewFields.title: Protective Technologies for Reliable Performance
overviewFields.value: Incorporating McIntosh's proprietary Power Guard® technology, the MC257 prevents speaker damage caused by clipping or overdriving. The Sentry Monitor™ system safeguards against short circuits by disengaging the output stage if current exceeds safe levels, automatically resetting when normal conditions resume. These protective measures ensure the amplifier's longevity and dependable performance.

overviewFields.title: Elegant Design with User-Friendly Features
overviewFields.value: The MC257 boasts a polished stainless-steel chassis and the iconic McIntosh black glass front panel, complete with the TripleView™ meter, illuminated logo, and aluminum end caps. The front panel utilizes direct LED backlighting for enhanced color accuracy and durability. Updated gold-plated speaker binding posts prevent corrosion and ensure a high-quality signal transmission to your speakers.

products.name: Denon DCD-600NE CD Player with AL32 Processing

overviewFields.title: Advanced CD Playback
overviewFields.value: Listen to superior audio and masterfully reproduced songs with the Denon DCD-600NE CD Player. With Denon-proprietary AL32 Processing technology, combined with an innovative circuitry structure, ensure recordings are accurately reproduced and beautifully faithful to the original sound. More than a CD player, the DCD-600NE supplies even higher quality audio signals to the amplifier. Vibration-resistant design reduces adverse audio effects of heavy components within amplifiers, guaranteeing the sound quality meets rigorous Denon standards. And with a more than 100-year legacy of crafting audio components, trust Denon to achieve an amazing sound that exceeds your expectations.

overviewFields.title: AL32 Processing
overviewFields.value: The DCD-600NE is equipped with AL32 Processing, a proprietary analog waveform reproduction technology from Denon. AL32 Processing utilizes data interpolation algorithms, which add in the points that should exist before and after large quantities of data, smoothing out the waveform and restoring information that was lost during the digital recording. The resulting playback is highly detailed, free of interferences, richly expressive in the lower range, and beautifully faithful to the original sound. Listen to songs as the artist intended.

overviewFields.title: CD, CD-R/RW, MP3, and WMA Support
overviewFields.value: Enjoy extended disc support for your cherished music collection. The DCD-600NE plays back your CDs, CD-R/RW, MP3, and WMA formats. Listen to your favorite audio formats and feel the powerful fidelity DCD-600NE provides.

overviewFields.title: Advanced Circuitry with Minimized Signal Paths
overviewFields.value: The circuit patterns in the DCD-600NE are thoughtfully engineered to make signal paths as short as possible. With layered circuit boards and shorter circuits, the interference between circuits and left and right channels is reduced, and the adverse influences on audio signals are minimized. As a result, the circuit paths in the DCD-600NE reproduce sound that’s clean, highly transparent, and faithful to the original recording.

overviewFields.title: Optical Output
overviewFields.value: The DCD-600NE features one Optical output to connect to the digital input of an amplifier or AV receiver.

overviewFields.title: Pure Direct Mode
overviewFields.value: Listen with Pure Direct Mode on the DCD-600NE. Pure Direct Mode deactivates the digital output and the display which might otherwise color the signal. What you hear is a cleaner, more detailed, accurate sound.

overviewFields.title: Vibration-Resistant Design for Pristine Sound
overviewFields.value: Vibration-resistant design reduces the adverse audio effects of heavy components within amplifiers so that sound quality meets Denon standards. A power transformer is fitted immediately above the insulators to prevent unwanted vibration. By placing the transformer close to the foot, the vibration surrounding the chassis is reduced, resulting in pristine sound. The name for it is Direct Mechanical Ground Construction. Now in addition to a metal bracket connecting the CD mechanism and chassis to the high-density feet, unwanted resonance is further reduced to deliver pristine sound.

overviewFields.title: Direct Mechanical Ground Construction
overviewFields.value: The DCD-600NE features a metal chassis to achieve high mechanical stability to suppress vibration caused by disc rotation.

overviewFields.title: Build Integrity with Thoughtfully Selected Components
overviewFields.value: With more than a 100-year legacy of designing premium audio components, trust that your Denon product has undergone rigorous testing. The overall aesthetic, sound quality, and design integrity of DCD-600NE and its Hi-Fi components are built to last.

overviewFields.title: 100+ Years of Firsts in Audio Technology
overviewFields.value: Founded in 1910, Denon has a deep heritage of "firsts" in audio technology — from Japan’s first audio electronics manufacturer to producing the world’s first commercial CD player and Dolby Atmos-enabled AV receiver. This focused investment in audio R&D ensures you get the latest technology and highest quality with every listening experience.

overviewFields.title: Reinventing an Icon
overviewFields.value: By adapting to today’s media sources and using state-of-the-art digital technology for the new world of digital music, the D 3020 puts a completely modern spin on a revered icon. The original designer of the 3020, NAD’s Director of Advanced Technology, Bjorn Erik Edvardsen, has been pivotal in developing the D 3020 for the new digital generation. Offering an excellent quality 24/192 DAC with 8 channels mixed to 2 for improved resolution, the D 3020 V2 represents the same kind of value-bending innovation that gave the original 3020 its legendary overachieving phono stage.

overviewFields.title: More Connected
overviewFields.value: The D 3020 offers inputs for your digital and analogue sources. Coaxial and optical inputs allow many different digital sources to be connected, from CD and DVD players, to set-top boxes, media streamers like AppleTV, or satellite and cable receivers. There are also analogue inputs including a sophisticated MM Phono input. Far from just another set of sockets, this Phono stage includes highly accurate RIAA equalization, an Infrasonic Warp Filter, and features both high overload margins and extremely low noise. With V2, NAD has also added a PreOut for increased connectivity in the output stage.

overviewFields.title: Power that Delivers
overviewFields.value: Power output may sound small at 40W per channel, but like all NAD amplifiers, this is very misleading, as a properly designed 40W amplifier can sound superior to a 100W amplifier from a lesser brand. With its very small form factor, the D 3020 will astound many for its ability to drive difficult loudspeakers to satisfying levels without adding noise or distortion.

overviewFields.title: Real World Performance
overviewFields.value: NAD rewrote the rules for amplifiers when designing the original 3020. Instead of letting laboratory test equipment have the last word, NAD made sure that they could properly drive real loudspeakers with real music for the real world. The D 3020 lives up to this promise through a unique implementation of NAD PowerDrive developed by Edvardsen, that allows low impedance drive (current) and high dynamic power (voltage) at vanishingly low distortion levels. This refinement of PowerDrive combined with a precision soft clipping circuit, lets the D 3020 sound even more powerful than it already is. An innovative Bass EQ circuit helps small speakers sound big without overdriving or damaging ported woofers.

overviewFields.title: Stream with Bluetooth
overviewFields.value: The D 3020 V2 delivers the convenience of wireless streaming with its Bluetooth capability. Stream all your music from a smartphone, tablet, or laptop. The D 3020 even supports the highest audio quality Bluetooth, aptX, which is becoming ever more popular for its excellent sound quality and low power consumption compared to Wi-Fi.

overviewFields.title: Mean and Green
overviewFields.value: The D 3020’s highly efficient design wastes less energy, requiring only 20% of the power needed by traditional Hi-Fi amplifiers. It’s like trading in a gas guzzling car for a hybrid vehicle. Standby power consumption is a miniscule <0.5W. NAD has taken amplification to new lows, with lower distortion, lower noise, and lower power consumption. NAD’s major focus is to find new technology that improves musical performance while consuming less power and using fewer non-renewable resources in manufacturing.

products.name: Record Doctor VI Record Cleaning Machine with RxLP Cleaning Solution - 20th Anniversary Edition (Gloss Black), Low Profile Record Clamp, and 12" Cork Turntable Slipmat

overviewFields.title: Major New Upgrade to the Record Doctor "For Those Who Love and Care for Their Vinyl"
overviewFields.value: The new Record Doctor VI Record Cleaning Machine is the first major upgrade to the original Record Doctor V in the last ten years. This new machine is quieter and cleans better than all previous Record Doctor generations. And that's saying a lot, considering that the Record Doctor has won praise from Stereophile, The Absolute Sound, and AnalogPlanet.com.

overviewFields.title: Better in So Many Ways!
overviewFields.value: The Record Doctor VI is loaded with improvements to make your entire record cleaning experience better than ever before. There are so many enhancements, they take a while to list!

overviewFields.title: Hear the Music You've Been Missing!
overviewFields.value: Vacuum cleaning your records with the Record Doctor VI is the best way to get dirt, dust, and grime out of the grooves and let you hear the music you've been missing. The Record Doctor VI brings a number of benefits to LP listening. It improves the sound quality, helps your records maintain their value, and helps extend the life of your LPs. Cleaner records sound better than dirty records. With a clean LP, your record stylus reproduces the music the way the artist intended it to sound – instead of plaguing you with clicks, pops, surface noise, and distortion.

overviewFields.title: Higher Value, Longer Lasting
overviewFields.value: It just makes sense that clean, well cared for records are worth more than dirty, poor sounding discs. Protect your valuable vinyl investment with the Record Doctor VI. Vinyl discs can become so dirty that they are virtually unplayable. According to Gerald L. Gibson, Head of the Motion Picture, Broadcasting, and Recorded Sound Division of the Library of Congress, "Dust can become embedded permanently into the disc's grooves, causing distortion of the transmitting signal, ticks, pops, and inferior sound quality." If you enjoy listening to vinyl, you can hardly afford not to get a Record Doctor VI vacuum-powered record cleaner. It not only cleans your records, but it can also help prolong their life by keeping them free of dust, dirt, and grime.

overviewFields.title: Quick, Easy, and Safe to Use
overviewFields.value: Record Doctor VI is so quick and easy to use, it only takes a minute or so to clean both sides of an LP. With its Clean Sweep fluid application brush, soft sweeper strips, and specially formulated record cleaning fluid, Record Doctor VI is safe for all of your LPs. And Record Doctor RxLP cleaning solution is a non-alcohol industrial-grade cleaner safe for all vinyl records.

overviewFields.title: Turn Your Records by Hand and Save a Handful of Cash
overviewFields.value: The vacuum-powered Record Doctor is the most highly recommended low-price record cleaning machine in the world. Stereophile magazine calls the Record Doctor, "the least expensive way to effectively clean records." Record Doctor VI features the same vacuum motor and vacuum cleaning strip as much more expensive machines, but it does not have the expensive motor that turns records for you. So, turn the records by hand, and save a handful of cash!

overviewFields.title: Low Mass Design – Way Better Than A Record Weight
overviewFields.value: To extract maximum sonic performance from vinyl, most high-end turntables now come with record clamps rather than record weights because a record clamp has several advantages over record weights. Weighing only 5.4 ounces (153 grams), the Record Doctor Record Clamp’s low mass design does not apply excessive stress to turntable bearings like record weights can, improving bearing performance and life expectancy. The clamp’s gentle action won't damage LP labels.

overviewFields.title: Beautifully Designed and Engineered
overviewFields.value:
The Record Doctor Record Clamp is beautifully designed and engineered with a black non-resonant phenolic body. The carbon steel collet clamps tightly to most turntable spindles, while the textured stainless steel knob allows for precise clamping pressure.

*Note: Be sure to measure the clearance between your LP record and turntable dustcover before ordering to ensure a proper fit.

*Note: Not recommended for use with Rega turntables

overviewFields.title: Can I use Bluetooth as soon as I plug in the speaker?
overviewFields.value: Era 100 must first be set up on WiFi using the Sonos app. Following setup, you can easily pair a Bluetooth device by pressing the button on the back of the speaker. overviewFields.title: Where should I place Era 100?
overviewFields.value: Designed for versatility, Era 100 fits almost anywhere, including enclosed spaces such as a bookshelf. It’s also humidity resistant, so you can place it in the kitchen or on a covered patio.

overviewFields.title: Does Era 100 support stereo pairing?
overviewFields.value: Yes. For an even wider soundstage, you can stereo pair two Era 100 speakers in the same room. These can also be used as rear speakers for surround sound with Arc, Beam (any generation), or Ray. Era 100 will not pair with Sonos One, One SL, or Play:1.

overviewFields.title: Which soundbars can I use with Era 100 for surround sound?

overviewFields.title: How do I use Trueplay™ to tune Era 100?
overviewFields.value: The Trueplay tuning experience differs slightly for Android and iOS. With an Android device, Trueplay relies on the microphones of the speaker. With an iOS device, you have the option to use this Trueplay method  (referred to as Quick Tuning in the Sonos app) or the traditional method (referred to as Advanced Tuning) which uses the microphones in your iPhone or iPad and requires you to move around the room. Please note that if you use a pair of Era 100 speakers for surround sound with your Sonos soundbar, Trueplay will require a supported iOS device.

overviewFields.title: Which subwoofer should I pair with Era 100?
overviewFields.value: We recommend pairing Era 100 with Sub Mini or Sub. All generations of Sub are compatible.

overviewFields.title: Can I experience Dolby Atmos with Era 100?
overviewFields.value: The acoustic architecture of Era 100 does not support playback of spatial audio content.

overviewFields.title: How can I use line in?
overviewFields.value: To connect an audio device directly to Era 100, you need to use the Sonos Line-In Adapter and a 3.5 mm auxiliary cable, both sold separately.

overviewFields.title: What's the difference between Bluetooth and WiFi?
overviewFields.value: A WiFi connection provides the best listening experience, allowing you to stream lossless audio from anywhere in your home. Bluetooth allows you to quickly connect a phone, tablet, or laptop to your speaker and stream compressed audio directly from the paired device — without the Sonos app but within a limited range.

overviewFields.title: Can I use Bluetooth with a stereo pair?
overviewFields.value: If you have created a stereo pair, you can still stream audio using Bluetooth. Please note that if you use a pair of speakers for home theater surround sound, Bluetooth and Line-In will be disabled.

overviewFields.title: Can I group speakers while using Bluetooth?
overviewFields.value: Yes. Similar to the experience with Sonos Roam and Move, if you are playing content from a Bluetooth source, you can group Era 100 with other products in your Sonos system that are connected to WiFi.

overviewFields.title: Can I use a third-party adapter for line in?
overviewFields.value: No. Most, if not all, of the USB-C to 3.5 mm adapters on the market today are intended for line out (headphones) and do not.

overviewFields.title: What is spatial audio?
overviewFields.value: While audio mixed in stereo is limited to left and right channels with elements localized within a horizontal plane, spatial audio technologies, such as Dolby Atmos, allow creators to place individual sounds all around you in 3D space for a more immersive and realistic listening experience. When you enjoy spatial audio content on Era 300, the speaker receives the audio signal and re-creates the immersive sound field in your home.

overviewFields.title: How can I experience spatial audio on Era 300?

overviewFields.title: Can I use Bluetooth as soon as I plug in the speaker?
overviewFields.value: Era 100 must first be set up on WiFi using the Sonos app. Following setup, you can easily pair a Bluetooth device by pressing the button on the back of the speaker. Please note that if you use a pair as rear speakers for home theater surround sound, Bluetooth will be disabled.

overviewFields.title: Where should I place Era 100?
overviewFields.value: Designed for versatility, Era 100 fits almost anywhere, including enclosed spaces such as a bookshelf. It’s also humidity resistant, so you can place it in the kitchen or on a covered patio.

overviewFields.title: Does Era 100 support stereo pairing?
overviewFields.value: Yes. For an even wider soundstage, you can stereo pair two Era 100 speakers in the same room. These can also be used as rear speakers for surround sound with Arc, Beam (any generation), or Ray. Era 100 will not pair with Sonos One, One SL, or Play:1.

overviewFields.title: Which soundbars can I use with Era 100 for surround sound?
overviewFields.value: Pair two Era 100 speakers with Arc, Beam (any generation), or Ray for surround sound. Era 100 is not compatible with Playbar or Playbase.

overviewFields.title: How do I use Trueplay™ to tune Era 100?
overviewFields.value: The Trueplay tuning experience differs slightly for Android and iOS. With an Android device, Trueplay relies on the microphones of the speaker. With an iOS device, you have the option to use this Trueplay method  (referred to as Quick Tuning in the Sonos app) or the traditional method (referred to as Advanced Tuning) which uses the microphones in your iPhone or iPad and requires you to move around the room. Please note that if you use a pair of Era 100 speakers for surround sound with your Sonos soundbar, Trueplay will require a supported iOS device.

overviewFields.title: Which subwoofer should I pair with Era 100?
overviewFields.value: We recommend pairing Era 100 with Sub Mini or Sub. All generations of Sub are compatible.

overviewFields.title: Can I experience Dolby Atmos with Era 100?
overviewFields.value: The acoustic architecture of Era 100 does not support playback of spatial audio content.

overviewFields.title: How can I use line in?
overviewFields.value: To connect an audio device directly to Era 100, you need to use the Sonos Line-In Adapter and a 3.5 mm auxiliary cable, both sold separately.

overviewFields.title: What's the difference between Bluetooth and WiFi?
overviewFields.value: A WiFi connection provides the best listening experience, allowing you to stream lossless audio from anywhere in your home. overviewFields.title: Can I use Bluetooth with a stereo pair?

overviewFields.title: Can I group speakers while using Bluetooth?

overviewFields.title: Can I use a third-party adapter for line in?
overviewFields.value: No. Most, if not all, of the USB-C to 3.5 mm adapters on the market today are intended for line out (headphones) and do not.

overviewFields.title: Where should I place Era 300?
overviewFields.value: For optimal sound quality, Era 300 should be placed indoors and have approximately two feet of overhead clearance. Placement in an enclosed space such as a bookshelf is not recommended as this could impact dispersion and playback clarity.

overviewFields.title: Does Era 300 support stereo pairing?
overviewFields.value: Yes. For an even wider soundstage and more depth, pair two Era 300 speakers in the same room. These can also be used as rear speakers for multichannel surround sound with Arc or Beam (Gen 2).

overviewFields.title: What soundbars will pair with Era 300 for surround sound?
overviewFields.value: Because Era 300 is a multichannel rear speaker, it requires a Sonos soundbar that supports Dolby Atmos, i.e. Arc or Beam (Gen 2). For this reason, Era 300 is not compatible with Playbar, Playbase, Beam (Gen 1), or Ray.

overviewFields.title: Which subwoofer should I pair with Era 300?
overviewFields.value: Era 300 has great bass on its own.  For a richer, more powerful sound experience, we recommend pairing Era 300 with Sub (any generation).

overviewFields.title: What is spatial audio?
overviewFields.value: While audio mixed in stereo is limited to left and right channels with elements localized within a horizontal plane, spatial audio technologies, such as Dolby Atmos, allow creators to place individual sounds all around you in 3D space for a more immersive and realistic listening experience. When you enjoy spatial audio content on Era 300, the speaker receives the audio signal and re-creates the immersive sound field in your home.

overviewFields.title: How can I experience spatial audio on Era 300?
overviewFields.value: To experience music in spatial audio, you’ll need to be connected to WiFi and streaming Dolby Atmos Music from a supported service. Refer to https://support.sonos.com/article/listen-to-dolby-atmos-music-on-sonos for more information.

overviewFields.title: Can I use Bluetooth® as soon as I plug in the speaker?
overviewFields.value: Era 300 must first be set up on WiFi using the Sonos app. Following setup, you can easily pair a Bluetooth device by pressing the button on the back of the speaker. Please note that if you use a pair as rear speakers for home theater surround sound, Bluetooth will be disabled.

overviewFields.title: What's the difference between Bluetooth and WiFi?
overviewFields.value: A WiFi connection provides the best listening experience, allowing you to stream lossless and spatial audio from anywhere in your home. Bluetooth allows you to quickly connect a phone, tablet, or laptop to your speaker and stream audio directly from the paired device — without the Sonos app but within a limited range.

overviewFields.title: Can I use Bluetooth with a stereo pair?
overviewFields.value: If you have created a stereo pair, you can still stream audio using Bluetooth. Please note that if you use a pair of speakers for home theater surround sound, Bluetooth and Line-In will be disabled.

overviewFields.title: Can I group speakers while using Bluetooth?
overviewFields.value: Yes. Similar to the experience with Sonos Roam and Move, if you are playing content from a Bluetooth source, you can group Era 300 with other products in your Sonos system that are connected to WiFi.

overviewFields.title: How can I use line in?
overviewFields.value: To connect an audio device directly to Era 300, you need to use the Sonos Line-In Adapter and a 3.5 mm auxiliary cable, both sold separately.

overviewFields.title: How do I connect my turntable to Sonos?
overviewFields.value: You can connect your turntable to Era 300 using the Sonos Line-In Adapter and an auxiliary cable.

products.name: Kanto ORA Powered Reference Desktop Speakers with Bluetooth - Pair (Black)

overviewFields.title: Everything A Desktop Speaker Should Be
overviewFields.value: Creator. Gamer. Musician. No matter how you define yourself, you deserve defined sound. ORA bridges the gap between computer speakers and studio monitors giving you studio-grade, audiophile-approved sound without dominating your space. ORA has modern inputs like USB-C to get the best sound from your PC or Mac, Bluetooth ® 5.0 to pair with your phone or smart home device, and RCA for your analog gear. Sporting a crossover that automatically sends bass to a connected subwoofer, you get flawless low-end integration freeing up the 3” woofers and ¾” silk dome tweeters to focus on what they do best. ORA is the perfect blend of reference-quality sound and modern features at a compact size to fit on your desktop.

overviewFields.title: Reference Quality
overviewFields.value: 100W of DSP-tuned, bi-amplified Class-D power for near studio-grade sound with shockingly deep bass from its 3” woofers. Linear enough to pull double duty as a studio monitor and a multimedia speaker.

overviewFields.title: Plug ‘N Play
overviewFields.value: ORA desktop speakers feature three inputs covering your digital and analog needs. USB-C to get the best sound from your PC or Mac, Bluetooth 5.0 pairs seamlessly with your phone or smart home device, and RCA for your analog gear.

overviewFields.title: Seamless Sub Integration
overviewFields.value: A crossover network kicks in automatically when a sub is connected letting ORA focus on vocals and high frequencies. By relieving ORA of sub-bass duties, you can play louder with less distortion.

overviewFields.title: Compact Size
overviewFields.value: Coming in at a fraction of the size of full-size bookshelf speakers, ORA is small enough to place sideways under a monitor or toss into a backpack for an impromptu recording session.

overviewFields.title: Retro Friendly
overviewFields.value: With magnetically shielded drivers, there’s no fear of placing ORA directly beside your CRT or high-end PVM. Hear every square wave and sawtooth in stunning detail from the analog RCA input.

overviewFields.title: Rear Mountable
overviewFields.value: A 1/4”-20 threaded insert located at the rear of each speaker lets you wall, or ceiling mount ORA with any compatible speaker mounting bracket.

overviewFields.title: A True All-in-One Audio System
overviewFields.value: The Alpha iQ sets a new benchmark for modern, tangle-free, audiophile-grade listening. The two speakers have 180W of built-in amplification and a network streamer based on the award-winning BluOS multi-room music platform. The left and right speakers communicate via a wireless link that can cover most rooms in an average-size home without delays or latency, so that music stays synched and clear regardless of speaker placement.

overviewFields.title: Small but Mighty
overviewFields.value: Available in 5 stunning Matte finishes, the Alpha iQ has a sleek, modern design. Inside each enclosure is a 4” polypropylene mid-bass driver with steel basket and rubber surround, and a 0.75” aluminum dome tweeter with neodymium magnet and ferrofluid damping. Each woofer has its own 60W class-D amplifier, and each tweeter its own 30W class-D amp, for a total system output of 180W.

overviewFields.title: DSP-Based Active Crossover
overviewFields.value: The Alpha iQ employs a DSP-based active crossover. Thanks to their powerful amplifiers, tuned bass ports, and DSP-enabled low-frequency extension, PSB’s Alpha iQ speakers can deliver bass output that completely belies their diminutive size. The Alpha iQ’s audiophile-grade DAC supports resolution to 24-bit/192kHz and has full MQA decoding and rendering capability for high-res streaming from Tidal.

overviewFields.title: Unlimited Music
overviewFields.value: Through the BluOS Controller app, you can play music from more than 20 streaming services including several that offer lossless and high-resolution audio, such as Amazon Music, Deezer, Idagio, Qobuz, and Tidal as well as internet radio stations from around the world. Apple Airplay 2, Spotify Connect and Tidal Connect are also supported. For listening options beyond streaming, a built-in MM preamp, RCA phono jacks and ground terminal allows you to connect a turntable. Other inputs include an HDMI eARC port for connecting to an HDTV, an optical input for connecting a disc player or game console, and a 3.5mm auxiliary input for connecting analog sources. The Alpha iQ also has Bluetooth connectivity, with support for the high-quality aptX-HD codec, for wireless playback from smart devices. You can connect an external drive loaded with music files to the Alpha iQ’s USB port and control playback.

overviewFields.title: Complete Control
overviewFields.value: Listeners can control every aspect of the Alpha iQ’s operation with the BluOS Controller app, which is available for Android, iOS, macOS, and Windows. Touch controls on the top of the primary speaker also provide immediate access for changing volume, pausing and resuming playback.

overviewFields.title: Integration
overviewFields.value: Like all BluOS-enabled components, the Alpha iQ can be integrated into popular smart home systems like Control4, Crestron, ELAN, RTI, and URC. Voice control is possible using Amazon Alexa, Google Assistant, and Apple Siri (via AirPlay 2). IR learning is also available for listeners who use harmonized remotes that can operate multiple A/V components.

products.name: iFi Audio iPower X 12V Active Noise Cancelling DC Power Supply

overviewFields.title: Pure silence. Clean power to the maX.
overviewFields.value: With crème de la crème components and tech, the iFi iPower X deep cleans the background noise created in your mains power. Can now be used with a wider variety of equipment.

overviewFields.title: Silence. Personified.
overviewFields.value: The original iFi iPower provides an effective, clean power solution for noise in your system. But why not push your power upgrade to the max with the all-new iFi iPower X? iFi's new ultra-low noise AC/DC power supply has be optimized to take advantage of new knowledge, components and tech in the world of super high-frequency power supply design.

overviewFields.title: Active cancellation
overviewFields.value: The iPower X uses Active Noise Cancellation II  to cancel all incoming EMI or RFI noise. This is the same tech as in active noise-cancelling headphones! Imagine how well these block out cabin noise on a plane compared to regular headphones? This is what the iPower X does to your power supply.

overviewFields.title: Improved capacitance
overviewFields.value: As usual with iFi, every new design means not only improving how it looks on the outside but more importantly, how it functions on the inside. The input capacitance is now 50% larger and the output capacitance is 150% larger when compared to the original iPower. In practical terms, this gives you more filtration, improved dynamics and unsurpassed sound quality.

overviewFields.title: Crème de la crème components
overviewFields.value: iFi is using the latest solid organic capacitors for better suppression of high-frequency noise. And the leakage capacitance is some 20x lower than your normal SMPS! In a nutshell, there is no escape for unwanted noise! All in all, the iPower X will give you 20% more power than the original iFi iPower and increased amperage which means it can work with more equipment than ever before.

overviewFields.title: Sleek, modern design
overviewFields.value: The iPower X comes dressed in a new cream/beige chassis for a cool, clean look. We’ve added several openings and the iFi logo backlit by a pleasant cyan LED light. There’s no second-guessing when this mini work of art is on and connected to the mains. And as always, iFi is giving you freedom. The iPower X is interchangeable with wall pin types across the world (UK/US/EU/AU purchased separately).

overviewFields.title: Because iFi plays music too…
overviewFields.value: Musician? Loving your effect pedals but not so much one when goes down in the middle of a gig? And your spare is nowhere to be found? iFi iPower X has a centre negative adapter so you can use this correctly with your gear. Cleaner sound AND the show goes on! What’s not to like?

overviewFields.title: iPowerX for LED lights
overviewFields.value: Photography? No way. iPowerX can also solve my flickering LED light problem? Yes, a constant current and voltage power supply like iPowerX will ensure that the current supplied to your LED system will remain stable, no matter the fluctuations of the AC power in your wall socket.

overviewFields.value: To quieter and beyond.

overviewFields.title: Come on, heal the noise!
overviewFields.value: Got underlying noise in your system? An irritating noise that you can’t explain? Sonics grainy? It could be as simple as your power supply. Upgrade to the iFi iPower2 to feed your system’s circuits with ultra-quiet, ultra-clean audiophile-grade power.

overviewFields.title: Noise-Cancellation culture.
overviewFields.value: The new iPower2 boasts improved components and a thicker gauge of wiring to deliver improved output/input noise suppression. overviewFields.title: iPower2 the people!

overviewFields.title: Flashdance?

products.name: Dekoni Audio Headphone Savior - Universal Headphone Carrying Case

overviewFields.title: Description
overviewFields.value:
Dekoni Audio's Headphone Savior is built with the traveling audiophile in mind. Based on the philosophy of traditional camera bags-which protect thousands of dollars in equipment-we've applied that same standard of safety to your audio gear.

With thick padding on all sides, a variety of internal configurations, and a design meant to accommodate headphones, cables, DACs, and anything else needed on the go, you can trust the Savior to keep your investment safe and worry-free. The Classic: Headphone Savior V1 (Medium) For those who prioritize a compact footprint.

If you are looking for a more compact softshell case to keep traveling easy and comfortable, the tried-and-true original Savior is the perfect fit. Compact Design: The V1 features a shorter vertical profile designed to take up as little space as possible in your luggage or backpack while still offering robust protection.

Proven Protection: Just like the V2, it features thick padding and modular dividers to secure your DACs and cables alongside your headphones. The New Standard: Charcoal Headphone Savior V2 (Large) For those who need maximum room and flexibility.

The Version 2 of the Headphone Savior (Charcoal) introduces a raft of changes for those who found the original design a little too snug. The defining feature of the V2 is the increased height, expanding the original's internal space by 3cm.

You will never have to worry about a tight squeeze again. Extra Depth for Cables: The V2 comes with two internal dividers.

One lines the bottom of the case; removing this frees up even more depth, maximizing the available space for headphones with rigid, permanently attached cables. Customizable Interior: Included are a variety of pockets and dividers, giving you the customization options needed to protect any style of headphone.

Travel Ready: Includes a shoulder strap for hands-free travel and a climbing loop on the back for carabiners to strap it to other bags. Comparison: Which Savior is right for you?

While both cases offer the same high-quality softshell protection, heavy-duty padding, and modular dividers, the choice comes down to the size of your headphones and your cabling needs. Choose the Savior V1 (Original) if: You own standard-sized headphones with detachable cables and want a case that is as slim and portable as possible.

Choose the Savior V2 (Charcoal) if: You have large headphones, use thick aftermarket cables, or have headphones with permanently attached cables that require extra depth (an extra 3cm) to sit comfortably without bending.

products.name: Eletech Baroque Stage | Luxury HiFi Eartips for IEMs

overviewFields.title: Description
overviewFields.value:
Baroque Stage by Eletech Marks the Next Chapter in Elite Audio, Ushering in a New Era of Comfort, Isolation, and Sonic Finesse Includes (2x) pairs of eartips per set Successor to the beloved original Eletech Baroque eartips Features a new proprietary material, Sonar-X™ Next-gen composition delivers a firmer structure for improved audio accuracy Made with hypoallergenic material and Japanese medical grade silicon Baroque Stage The “Baroque Stage” is a natural evolution of Eletech’s luxury eartip line—an elevated variant crafted for listeners who demand precision, structure, and nuance. Building upon the foundational elegance of the original Baroque collection, “Baroque Stage” introduces a new proprietary material, ‘Sonar-X™’, engineered with nano hexagonal patterns to enhance acoustic transmission and elevate detail retrieval.

This next-gen composition offers a firmer structure for improved audio accuracy, while a refined surface texture optimizes interaction with ‘TRIA™’ and strengthens the support for ‘Flexion™’, ensuring a secure yet adaptive fit. The “Baroque Stage” is tailored for audiophiles who seek a more defined listening experience, delivering a distinct blend of control, comfort, and tonal fidelity—true to Eletech’s pursuit of excellence in form and function.

An Unparalleled Audio Experience With Baroque Stage, a newly developed, sturdier compound enhances structural integrity while preserving comfort and control. Tuned meticulously based on user feedback, these eartips strike a perfected balance of form and function, delivering exceptional clarity, stability, and immersive sound.

Every aspect has been thoughtfully refined, embodying Eletech’s commitment to precision and listener-centric design. The ‘Baroque’ Series embodies impeccable comfort at its core.

Through extensive user feedback and continuous refinement, Eletech identified the need for a different kind of fit—one that caters to varied ear shapes and listening preferences. Dozens of prototypes were crafted and evaluated, with each iteration shaped by real-world insights.

The result is a design that not only delivers a tailored ergonomic fit, but also introduces distinct acoustic characteristics, offering users an alternative sonic experience without compromising on long-wear comfort. Eletech Proprietary Design TRIA™ Reaffirming its place as a core element of Eletech’s design philosophy, ‘TRIA’ makes its return to the Baroque collection following strong user feedback.

Inspired by acoustic diffusion panels used in professional sound engineering, ‘TRIA’ strategically disperses sound waves to reduce unwanted resonances and reflections—resulting in a clean, immersive soundscape. Its intricate structure enhances soundstage performance, allowing instruments and vocals to bloom with natural depth and separation.

Flexion™ Reintroduced as a core component of the Baroque series, ‘Flexion’ returns by popular demand for its proven ergonomic excellence and adaptive fit. Inspired by origami, this structural feature enhances comfort by contouring naturally to the ear, ensuring a personalized and secure wearing experience.

In addition to its ergonomic strengths, ‘Flexion’ continues to play a crucial role in vibration control. By managing and dispersing micro-vibrations, it helps reduce resonance and distortion—delivering a purer, more accurate audio presentation.

Sonar-X™ ‘Sonar-X™’, a proprietary advanced material technology developed by Eletech, features ultra-fine wavy lines—an evolution from the original Baroque series—engineered to provide improved structure, enhanced support, and an even smoother surface texture. Refined through extensive user feedback, Sonar-X™ offers a more stable seal, greater comfort, and a luxuriously soft touch, redefining the wearing experience with both precision and elegance.

specifications.information: Headphone sensitivity measures how loud a pair of headphones will be at a given signal strength. Headphones with higher sensitivity ratings will produce louder sounds than headphones with lower sensitivity ratings. It is measured in dB SPL (decibels of sound pressure level) per unit of power (typically 1 milliWatt) or sometimes unit of voltage (typically 1 Volt) from the source at a frequency of 1 kHz.
specifications.title: Sensitivity

specifications.information: When driving headphones at high volumes, it is possible for the diaphragm (the ‘speaker’ inside the headphones) to be unable to move fast enough. This leads to distortion, manifesting itself as crackling, popping or the alteration of musical notes. Most headphones will fall below 1% THD.
specifications.title: Total Harmonic Distortion (THD)

specifications.information: Headphone frequency response refers to the frequency-specific sensitivity of the output. Frequency responses show the range that headphones are capable of reproducing—a graph shows which frequencies are accentuated over others. The ideal range covers the audible sound range of 20 Hz – 20 kHz.
specifications.title: Frequency Response

specifications.information: Headphone sensitivity measures how loud a pair of headphones will be at a given signal strength. Headphones with higher sensitivity ratings will produce louder sounds than headphones with lower sensitivity ratings. It is measured in dB SPL (decibels of sound pressure level) per unit of power (typically 1 milliWatt) or sometimes unit of voltage (typically 1 Volt) from the source at a frequency of 1 kHz.
specifications.title: Sensitivity

specifications.information: When driving headphones at high volumes, it is possible for the diaphragm (the ‘speaker’ inside the headphones) to be unable to move fast enough. This leads to distortion, manifesting itself as crackling, popping or the alteration of musical notes. Most headphones will fall below 1% THD.
specifications.title: Total Harmonic Distortion (THD)

specifications.information: Headphone frequency response refers to the frequency-specific sensitivity of the output. Frequency responses show the range that headphones are capable of reproducing—a graph shows which frequencies are accentuated over others. The ideal range covers the audible sound range of 20 Hz – 20 kHz.
specifications.title: Frequency Response

specifications.information: Warranty differs from manufacturer to manufacturer. It is always best to look at the manufacturer's website for the most up to date warranty information.

products.name: AudioQuest Black Beauty RCA Interconnect Cable - 4.92' (1.5m)

overviewFields.title: Description
overviewFields.value:
Black Beauty RCA cables bring the proven advantages of ZERO-Tech to a much wider audience. Featuring several AudioQuest design elements that work together to reduce distortion and efficiently dissipate radio-frequency noise.

Zero-Tech (No Characteristic Impedance) For Linear, Wide-Bandwidth Noise-Dissipation The only way to avoid characteristic-impedance mismatch-effects between a cable and its attached source and load circuits is to prevent the cable from having a characteristic-impedance. ZERO-Tech succeeds by eliminating the electrostatic field between the cable’s high and low signal conductors, enabling linear (consistent octave to octave) Radio-Frequency (RF) Noise-Dissipation, and uncompressed transients.

In order to preserve ZERO-Tech’s complete isolation between signal conductors, a Dual-72v DBS pack is included for Pegasus, ThunderBird, FireBird, and Dragon XLR cables. Solid Perfect-Surface Copper+ (PSC+) Conductors Solid conductors prevent electrical and magnetic strand-interaction.

PSC+ Solid-Copper minimizes distortion caused by grain boundaries and maximizes linear RF Noise-Dissipation. Foamed-Polyethylene Insulation Any solid material adjacent to a conductor is actually part of an imperfect circuit.

Wire insulation and circuit board materials all absorb energy. Some of this energy is stored and then released as distortion.

Because air absorbs next to no energy and Polyethylene is low-loss and has a benign distortion profile, Foamed-PE, with its high air content, causes much less of the out-of-focus effect common to other materials. Level 6 Noise-Dissipation (Interconnects): Zero-Tech + Carbon/Graphene Mesh-Network + Direction-Controlled Radio-Frequency Noise from cellular, WiFi, and satellites is everywhere.

AQ’s Level 6 Linear Noise-Dissipation includes a carbon & graphene resistive mesh-network, direction-controlled conductors, and Silver-Plated drain wires, significantly minimizing RF Noise masking effects. Copper-Plated RF-Draining Barrels Grounded Copper-Plated Barrels maximize Noise-Dissipation by preventing a metal barrel from capacitively coupling RF to the conductors.

Hanging-Silver Over Red-Copper Plugs AudioQuest’s finest plugs feature superior Hanging-Silver (not tumbled) directly over extreme-purity Red Copper to ensure uncompromised signal transfer.

SOLID PERFECT-SURFACE COPPER+ CONDUCTORS (PSC+): Perfect-Surface Copper+ has an astonishingly smooth and pure surface.

Proprietary metal-processing technology protects the wires surface at every stage of drawing and fabrication. When high-purity low-oxide copper is kept as soft, pure and smooth as possible, it becomes a wonderfully low-distortion PSC+ conductor.

PSC+ is manufactured by applying the same exceptional technology to an ultra-pure copper. The resulting sound quality is even more focused and simply less in the way.

CARBON-BASED 3-LAYER NOISE-DISSIPATION SYSTEM (NDS): 100% shield coverage is easy. Preventing captured RF Interference from modulating the equipments ground reference requires AQs Noise-Dissipation System.

Metal and Carbon-Loaded synthetics prevent most RFI from reaching the equipments ground plane. DOUBLE-BALANCED ASYMMETRICAL GEOMETRY: Purpose designed for single-ended applications, Double-Balanced Asymmetrical Geometry offers a relatively lower impedance on the ground for a richer, and more dynamic experience.

While many single-ended cable designs use a single path for both the ground and the shield, Double-Balanced designs separate the two for cleaner, quieter performance. COLD-WELDED DIRECT-SILVER PLATED PURE "PURPLE-COPPER" RCA PLUGS: This plug design allows for a connection devoid of solder, which is a common source of distortion.

Because the ground shells are stamped instead of machined, the metal can be chosen for low distortion instead of machinability. Purple-Copper offers a cleaner, clearer sound over nickel-plated or OFHC metals commonly found in competing manufacturers' plugs.

Direct-Silver Plating offers one more important step toward greater clarity and doing no harm to the signal.

The MQ112 addresses this by enabling direct adjustments to the audio signal, compensating for acoustic anomalies without the need for physical room modifications.

This results in a more enjoyable and accurate listening experience. Precise 8-Band Frequency Control Equipped with an 8-band analog equalizer, the MQ112 allows you to adjust the audio signal at eight critical frequency bands ranging from 25Hz to 10kHz.

This capability reveals nuances in vintage tracks, offering a refreshed and vibrant listening experience. Customizable Sound with TILT Function The TILT function provides an additional tonal adjustment of ±6dB, allowing you to subtly shift the balance between bass and treble.

This feature enables quick customization of the overall tonal character of your audio to match your preferences. Seamless Integration & Control The MQ112 includes both balanced and unbalanced inputs and outputs, ensuring compatibility with a wide range of audio systems.

The EQ Control knob allows for easy bypassing of the equalizer circuit, facilitating direct comparison between adjusted and unaltered audio. Additionally, the rear panel's EQ Control Trigger enables seamless integration with other system components, allowing for automated control based on input or amplifier selection.

Class A and fully-balanced at an unheard of price The Gremlin tube headphone amp is a little monster with a ferocious bite. With 1250mW of output power, it has the muscle to drive most headphones that cross its path.

It may be ugly, naked, and small, but don't judge a beast by its cover. For just $120, you're getting a Class A, fully-balanced tube amp with matched tubes—something unheard of at this price.

It delivers sound that’s sumptuous and lush, with musical tonality and heart-melting mids. Once it gets its claws in you, you won't want it to let go.

Feeding the beast: Tubes + transistors The Gremlin is a hybrid headphone amp that combines the precision of transistors with the warmth of vacuum tubes. While solid-state amps (which rely solely on transistors) deliver accuracy, they lack the soul of tubes.

In the Gremlin, the vacuum tubes in the pre-amp stage flood your music with rich harmonics and a warmth that solid-state amps can’t touch. Always hungry: the Gremlin's Class A appetite The Gremlin is a predator that never rests.

With a Class A design, it's always on the hunt, keeping the current flowing without pause. Other amps flip their transistors on and off to save energy and keep cool—efficient, sure, but prone to distortion that muddles the sound.

Not this beast. Its relentless operation means every note is delivered with the raw purity and ferocious detail that only Class A amplification can provide.

A poised predator: a fully-balanced amplifier With a fully-balanced design from input to output, the Gremlin cancels out the kind of hums, buzzes, and interference that can creep in with unbalanced systems. This means you get a cleaner sound—especially important if you're using sensitive headphones or high-end equipment that picks up every little detail.

The Gremlin gives you the best of both worlds: the warm, rich tones of tube amplification with the minimal interference of balanced design. Matched Ray Tubes: the Gremlin’s natural weapon The Gremlin comes armed with a matched pair of CORE 12AU7 from Ray Tubes to give you that signature tube warmth right out of the box.

When tubes are matched, it means they’ve been carefully tested to ensure they work together as a pair, delivering the same output and frequency response. This results in better soundstage, clarity, and stereo imaging—key elements for an hi-fi listening experience.

And if you're looking for even more depth and detail, we recommend upgrading to a pair of matched Ray Tubes SELECT 12AU7 tubes. Choose the 12AU7 SELECT and you'll get both sets—letting you tube roll and discover the extent of the Gremlin’s power.

Embark on the quest for your perfect sound The Gremlin Amp is made for audio lovers who want to explore the world of sound. It works with any 12AU7 or 6922 tubes, new or old, allowing you to easily swap and try new types.

Whether you prefer a lush or linear sound, the Gremlin lets you customize your audio setup whenever you want a change. STACK THE PARTY Add the Stacker to your order if you plan on using the Merlin DAC with the Gremlin amp.

This translucent acrylic platform lets you stack the two together like a proper adventuring party. It's precision-cut to cradle the Gremlin's lower acrylic plate and keep it snugly perched without adhesive or screws.

products.name: SJY Zeph Open-Back Planar Magnetic Headphones

overviewFields.title: Description
overviewFields.value:
Note: This product has a 1-2 week lead time for new orders. A one-piece headphone design The goal was straightforward: create a headphone with no resonance and a sound as dynamic and clean as possible.

That pursuit pushed SJY toward a simple yet radical solution: remove all non-essentials. The Zeph’s driver, chassis, and ear cup form a single precision-machined structure, reducing variables and minimizing vibration.

This approach enabled the thinnest chassis SJY could physically build—just 7mm—resulting in a fast, low-resonance open-back headphone with nothing standing between you and the music. Low distortion & minimal energy loss The Zeph’s goal is Immediate response, low distortion, and minimal energy loss.

Traditional headphones place a driver inside a cup, leaving multiple surfaces and interfaces that can vibrate. The Zeph eliminates those surfaces entirely.

With the driver itself being a single machined aluminum body, the entire assembly behaves as one piece: stable, rigid, and sonically quiet. This tighter control over motion enhances magnetic force efficiency, lowers distortion, and gives the Zeph its energetic, highly detailed character.

5mm connector. 5mm grille—stacked inside a CNC aluminum frame that keeps the driver perfectly rigid and stable.

Magnetic ear pads with dual tuning modes The Zeph’s ear pads attach magnetically, making them simple to remove and fast to swap. Each pad uses velour on the exterior and suede on the inner surfaces for a gentle seal and controlled treble response.

Flip the pads to switch between two voicings: Perforated side forward — more open, more spacious, laid-back vocals, enhanced instrument presence. Non-perforated side forward — warmer, more focused mids with forward vocals and increased texture.

Lightweight CNC aluminum construction All structural components, from the chassis to the headband frame, are CNC-machined aluminum engineered for rigidity and low mass. This keeps the Zeph stable on the head, eliminates unwanted vibrations, and complements the minimalist design philosophy that defines the headphone.

Two-layer full-grain leather headband A soft full-grain leather top strap provides natural comfort, while a heavier full-grain leather underside offers long-term resilience. Stainless steel reinforcement maintains a low profile while matching natural head geometry for an easy, even fit.

How we’re listening to it Tom at Apos here. I first heard the SJY Zeph at CanJam SoCal 2025, exactly one year after I’d been bowled over by Jeffrey’s Horizon Closed Carbon.

As I was sitting at the table listening to the Zeph, I couldn’t believe that he’d created not only another headphone that amazed me, but one that I liked just as much, if not more, than the Horizon Closed Carbon. As an open-back, it didn’t have quite the low-end as the Closed Carbon (no surprise there), but it provided a lushness and immediacy to vocals and mid-range instruments that I typically only find in dynamic drivers.

There was all the speed, imaging, and detail of a planar, but with the natural midrange timbre and tonality of a dynamic. ), I’m naturally a visual thinker, and when I’m listening to a product that I want to champion on Apos, I immediately start visualizing how I’m going to photograph it.

For the Zeph, that visual direction was color. Not coloration, per se, but color.

Like seeing all the colors of the wind. Like Remy from Ratatouille visualizing ingredients.

With the Zeph, music comes alive. Oh, and before I forget, I prefer the ear pads perforated side forward.

This disappearing act starts with an innovative, systematic approach to sound reproduction using transparency as the driving principle. Leveraging Sennheiser’s progressive production techniques and computer-based transducer optimization, it perfectly fuses the art of sound with the science of it.

Opening Up Your Mind The foundation of the HD 600 transducer system is an acoustically transparent open-back earcup that lets every single sound wave expand freely – a Sennheiser innovation pioneered and perfected for the most natural personal listening experience. Sound emanating from our exclusive 42mm driver is free from turbulence and distortion thanks to a specialized acoustic silk that controls airflow—one of the finest materials available for this task—while requiring hand assembly.

By using ultralight aluminum voice coils, the 38mm diaphragm exhibits rapid rest and response times for clinical detail that never sounds harsh or hyped. Across the entire audible spectrum of sound, this combination of driver size and integrity delivers an articulate response that is honest to the source—the kind of listening experience required to absorb the details with confidence.

The 300-ohm impedance of the HD 600 presents a unified backdrop that allows the nuances in your music collection to leap forward like you have never heard before. Each transducer is measured against rigid standards for consistent performance across the entire frequency spectrum in both channels.

By reducing variances between left and right channels, the headphone reproduces mastering-grade sound independent of room acoustics or loudspeaker positioning. Quality Control We worked tirelessly to build a headphone with the luxurious comfort and lasting durability audiophiles demand.

The velour HD 600 padding is supple to the touch for extended listening at your hi-fi stack. Even the earcup grille pattern was crafted specifically for this transducer system, guaranteeing a pristine personal sound experience.

products.name: GUSTARD R30 Fully-Discrete R2R Network Streaming DAC

overviewFields.title: Description
overviewFields.value:
Digital done differently The R30 is made for listeners who want digital done differently. Decoding is handled by a fully discrete R2R ladder network: resistors switching in perfect precision rather than the high-frequency 0/1 toggling of delta-sigma DACs.

The result is a sound that’s natural, detailed, and free of the digital edge. Around this core feature, the R30 applies serious engineering: true 1-bit DSD decoding, FPGA-based clock management, a self-developed network bridge, and a discrete Class-A analog output stage.

Together, these elements create a DAC that sounds utterly natural. Organic-sounding discrete R2R ladder The R30’s discrete R2R module converts digital signals directly through a resistor ladder network.

This design demands extreme resistor matching and precision, but it pays off with a more organic-sounding conversion. True 1-bit DSD decoding Native support for DSD1024 means the R30 can handle data density 1,024 times that of CD audio.

In DIRECT DSD mode, the bitstream bypasses PCM conversion entirely, decoded straight through a 1-bit switching array, which preserves micro-details and timing integrity. Smart digital filtering Three filter modes—Linear Sharp, Minimum Slow, and Super Slow—let you choose how the DAC shapes your sound.

Built on adaptive multi-order algorithms, the filtering reduces aliasing noise while enhancing resolution and dynamics. FPGA-powered control A programmable FPGA handles clock management, PLL shaping, depop switching, and signal routing.

This architecture lays the foundation for low jitter, stable synchronization, and customizable logic control that stays rock solid no matter how intricate the music gets. Precision OCXO clocking The SC-cut crystal OCXO clock keeps jitter to imperceptible levels thanks to exceptional thermal stability and stress resistance.

The R30 also accepts an external 10MHz clock input if you want to sync it to your reference system. A network bridge built for music The R30 comes with a self-developed CelWare-based network bridge system.

This isn’t a generic Linux box. It’s a playback-dedicated design that strips away non-audio processes, minimizing jitter and latency.

Protocol support includes Roon Bridge, AirPlay, HQPlayer NAA, UPnP/DLNA, Spotify Connect, MConnect, BubbleUPnP, and QQMusic. Class-A analog stage Instead of integrated op-amps, the R30’s discrete Class-A low-pass filter stage lets each component be tuned individually.

That means better control of frequency response, harmonic character, and transient handling. Passive relay preamplifier With its R2R relay-based volume control, the R30 doubles as a passive analog preamp.

Switch into pure bypass mode to use it strictly as a DAC, or connect it directly to powered monitors or a power amp and control volume remotely. XMOS USB with isolation The USB input runs on an XMOS XU216 interface, supporting PCM768k and DSD512.

Independent voltage regulation and isolated left/right channels keep crosstalk and interference to a minimum, ensuring your USB connection doesn’t become a weak link. 1in (530 × 400 × 180mm) Weight: 22lbs (10kg) What’s included R30 discrete R2R DAC Power cable Remote control User manual Featured reviews "A flawless-sounding unit.

products.name: Matrix NT-1 Network Transport

overviewFields.title: Description
overviewFields.value:
Network Audio Bridge The Matrix Audio NT-1 is a high-end network digital transport that brings streaming, local archiving, and precision clocking into a single, quiet, linear-powered chassis. It anchors a system with stable network playback, audio-focused outputs, CD ripping, and flexible storage options — giving you a dependable digital front end that fits neatly into an audiophile chain.

A new generation of streaming design The NT-1 adopts Matrix Audio’s newest design language and the same streaming hardware platform used in the M Series. It runs a more powerful processing core and a refined display, creating a smooth, responsive interface that supports long listening sessions without distraction.

Evolving software for daily use The MA Player operating system and MA Remote App continue to add features over time. Both iOS and Android devices pair naturally with the transport, giving you direct control over browsing, playback, library management, and transport functions from your phone or tablet.

Streaming services integrated directly The NT-1 places TIDAL, Qobuz, HIGHRESAUDIO, and internet radio inside the transport, reducing the need for external devices. Stream high-resolution libraries with consistent decoding and handoff to your DAC over optical, coaxial, AES/EBU, or IIS-LVDS.

Protocols built for modern libraries Roon Ready, Audirvana, TIDAL Connect, Spotify Connect, AirPlay 2, QPlay, and UPnP/DLNA support give you multiple ways to move audio across your home network. The NT-1 handles discovery and routing quietly in the background, leaving you free to use the control method that fits your habits.

Local and cloud music access Users who store music on a NAS can mount it directly to the transport and browse it like a built-in library. Cloud storage from Baidu Netdisk can also be mounted, allowing remote libraries to behave as if they were local.

0 ports let you attach both a USB drive and a USB CD drive simultaneously. This keeps physical media fully usable in a modern streaming system, with fast file access and stable, noise-reduced reading.

Simple file management The MA Remote App enables copying music from attached USB storage into internal SSD storage. No computer required — just direct file transfer into your library for long-term listening.

CD playback and ripping Connect a USB CD drive to play discs natively or rip them to internal storage. Metadata and album art are fetched during import, and users can edit tags directly in the MA Remote App for clean, well-organized archiving.

NVMe SSD storage with low-noise power An NVMe SSD slot on the bottom panel lets you expand internal storage. The SSD is powered by an isolated, ultra-low-noise supply that reduces electrical interference and keeps mechanical noise out of the listening space.

Shared storage across your network With SMB sharing enabled, any computer on your network can access the NT-1’s internal storage. The transport can also function as a small NAS, allowing other streamers on the same network to play its archived music.

Smart wake and trigger control The NT-1 wakes automatically when streaming begins or local music is selected. A rear trigger port can start a connected DAC or amplifier, creating a coordinated power sequence that reduces manual switching.

High-stability clock system The femtosecond clock and RF synthesizer deliver low-phase-noise performance in both internal and external clock modes. When paired with the Matrix Audio SC-1 external clock, the NT-1 synchronizes to an even higher-precision reference for users who want maximum timing accuracy.

Comprehensive digital outputs Optical, coaxial, AES/EBU, and IIS-LVDS outputs provide compatibility with a wide range of DACs and active speakers. Users who connect digital-input monitors can enable digital volume control and adjust output level directly from the transport.

Isolated USB DAC interface An audio-specific USB port uses electrical isolation to reduce ground noise and transmission interference. A dedicated low-noise linear regulator feeds this port separately from the digital section, preserving signal purity through the entire digital chain.

Flexible network expansion The SFP port supports optional optical or Ethernet modules. When paired with Matrix Audio’s audio-grade network switch, this creates a stable, noise-reduced connection path suitable for high-resolution playback.

Full linear power system A 60 W toroidal transformer and multiple LDO stages form the foundation of the NT-1’s power architecture. Independent windings feed the digital engine and USB DAC interface separately, reducing electrical coupling and maintaining stable operation under varying loads.

High-resolution Audio DAC The Schumann is a desktop DAC built around FPGA-based decoding, designed for systems that prioritize signal integrity, low noise, and straightforward control. It supports USB, coaxial, optical, I2S, and AES digital inputs, with both XLR and RCA analog outputs, covering common home and studio use without unnecessary extras.

FPGA-based digital decoding The Schumann uses an FPGA to handle its digital decoding and processing rather than relying on a fixed-function DAC pipeline. This approach allows tighter control over timing and data handling and supports jitter suppression at the hardware level.

The result is stable decoding across sources and formats, without leaning on software correction after the fact. High SNR for low-key detail The design emphasizes a high signal-to-noise ratio, which matters when the rest of your chain is quiet enough to reveal it.

With sensitive amplifiers or speakers, background noise stays controlled and low-level information remains intact. This is especially relevant for near-field and low-volume listening.

Digital inputs that cover common sources The input selection is practical and complete—USB for computers and streamers, coaxial and optical for transports and TVs, I2S for compatible sources, and AES for professional or studio gear. Multiple sources can stay connected at once, reducing cable swapping and simplifying daily use.

Balanced and unbalanced analog outputs The Schumann provides both XLR and RCA outputs, making it easy to integrate into balanced or single-ended systems. XLR is useful for longer cable runs or noise-sensitive setups, while RCA keeps compatibility with traditional integrated amps and preamps.

Direct front-panel control Physical buttons on the front panel handle power, input selection, and operating modes. OS/NOS switching is available without menus or apps, allowing you to change oversampling behavior quickly.

The control layout is functional and deliberately minimal. Dual crystal oscillator clocking The internal clocking uses a double crystal oscillator design to manage different sampling rates more precisely.

This helps maintain consistent timing as you move between sources and formats, supporting accurate signal reconstruction without additional intervention. 61 in (295 mm), Schumann fits comfortably on a desk, shelf, or equipment rack.

overviewFields.title: Description
overviewFields.value:
Cayin RU7 discrete 1-bit dongle DAC The Cayin RU7 is an ultra-portable USB-C dongle DAC built around a fully discrete 1-bit resistor network. It combines native DSD decoding, balanced and single-ended headphone outputs, and a hardware resistor ladder volume control in a compact metal chassis.

Designed for phones, tablets, and computers, the RU7 delivers precise digital-to-analog conversion without relying on an integrated DAC chip. Discrete 1-bit resistor ladder DAC The RU7 uses a fully-balanced discrete 1-bit DAC built from 128 high-precision thin-film resistors rather than an off-the-shelf DAC chip.

Incoming audio is converted to a DSD bitstream and processed through four parallel 1-bit DAC channels. This architecture prioritizes timing accuracy and low noise, helping preserve fine detail and stable channel balance during playback.

User-selectable all-to-DSD processing All incoming digital audio can be converted to DSD64, DSD128, or DSD256 before reaching the DAC stage. PCM is supported up to 384 kHz, and native DSD is supported from DSD64 through DSD256.

Converting everything to a single format simplifies signal handling and allows the discrete DAC stage to operate under consistent conditions. Parallel balanced headphone amplification The headphone amplifier stage uses dual amplifiers in parallel to deliver higher current and improved control.

5mm single-ended output delivers up to 160 mW into 32 ohms. This allows the RU7 to comfortably drive sensitive IEMs as well as many full-size headphones.

4mm outputs can be switched between headphone output and fixed-level line output. 4mm jack.

This makes it easy to use RU7 as a compact DAC feeding a portable amp, desktop amp, or home audio system. Discrete resistor ladder volume control Instead of digital attenuation or conventional analog potentiometers, the RU7 uses a discrete resistor ladder volume control with switching relays.

Volume adjustment is divided into three segments across 100 steps, allowing fine control at low listening levels while maintaining signal integrity. Short relay delays during adjustment are normal and intentional.

Low-noise dual-PCB design The digital and analog sections are separated across two six-layer circuit boards. This physical separation helps prevent clock and DSP noise from bleeding into the amplification stage.

The result is a quieter background and more consistent performance when connected to mobile devices. Low power consumption for mobile use The discrete DAC and amplifier stages are engineered for efficiency, keeping current draw around 100–110 mA.

This allows the RU7 to work reliably with phones, tablets, laptops, and USB-enabled digital audio players without excessive battery drain. 5 in (66 × 24 × 12 mm).

A CNC-machined metal chassis protects the internal circuitry, while a 128 × 64 pixel OLED screen shows playback format, sample rate, and volume level. Physical buttons provide direct volume and menu control.

Bundled magnetic leather case A handmade magnetic leather case is included for daily carry. The case is custom-fit for the RU7 with precise cutouts and includes two adhesive metal plates for magnetic attachment.

It offers added protection without obscuring the display or controls. 5 in (66 × 24 × 12 mm) What’s included RU7 dongle DAC USB-C cable USB-A to USB-C adapter User manual Magnetic leather protective case
